The AMP-2120-DNT is a compact 240W dual-mode amplifier designed for professional AV installations. It supports 70V/100V Hi-Z speaker systems or 4/8Ω Low-Z speaker loads, delivering up to 240W mono or 2×120W stereo from a half-rack, 1RU chassis. Built-in DSP provides EQ, filters, dynamics, delay, limiting, and matrix mixing for clear speech and optimized playback. With dual combo XLR/TRS mic inputs, 48V phantom power, automatic paging mute, LAN, Telnet, RS-232, and secure web GUI control, it integrates easily into classrooms, conference rooms, and multipurpose spaces.
1× hardware trigger input — auto-mutes speaker output on paging

Advanced 1 or 2 Channel Dante Amplifier with support for Low and High Impedance Speaker Systems

The AMP-2120-DNT is a compact, professional-grade amplifier designed for maximum flexibility in modern AV environments. Supporting both 70V/100V high-impedance or 4/8Ω low-impedance speaker loads, it delivers up to 240W of power in mono or 2x120W in stereo. Built-in DSP provides advanced audio processing—including gain, EQ, filters, dynamics, delay, and mixing—ensuring crystal-clear speech and optimized playback for any application. With flexible analog inputs, Dante connectivity, and intuitive control options via front panel, TCP/IP, or web GUI, the AMP-2120-DNT integrates seamlessly into classrooms, conference rooms, and multipurpose spaces. Automatic paging mute, security features, and comprehensive status indicators make it reliable for both critical communication and everyday use. Compact at just 0.5U, it offers powerful performance and versatility in a space-saving form factor.

The AMP-2120-DNT supports both local line-level and remote Dante audio inputs, allowing for a wide range of audio sources to be connected. This flexibility ensures that the amplifier can seamlessly integrate into any existing AV infrastructure, providing high-quality audio distribution across different zones.

The AMP-260-DNT supports both local line-level and remote Dante audio inputs, allowing for a wide range of audio sources to be connected. This flexibility ensures that the amplifier can seamlessly integrate into any existing AV infrastructure, providing high-quality audio distribution across different zones.

Equipped with a comprehensive digital signal processor (DSP), this amplifier offers extensive audio customization options including gain control, a limiter, five-band EQ, and up to 200ms of delay. These features enable users to fine-tune the audio output to match the specific requirements of the environment, ensuring an optimal listening experience.

With the capability to be powered either by a DC 24V 5A power supply or via PoE+, the AMP-2120-DNT offers unmatched operational flexibility. This dual power supply feature ensures that the amplifier can be easily installed and powered in a variety of settings, making it a versatile choice for different professional AV applications.

With the capability to be powered either by a DC 24V 5A power supply or via PoE+, the AMP-260-DNT offers unmatched operational flexibility. The amplifier is designed with user convenience in mind, featuring front panel volume controls and LED status indicators for easy operation. Moreover, it adheres to CA SB-327 compliance for secure web UI login controls, ensuring that system settings are protected and can be safely managed either locally or remotely.

The AMP-260-DNT is a cutting-edge two or four channel network amplifier designed to cater to the advanced audiovisual needs of professional environments such as medium to large meeting rooms and university lecture halls. This robust amplifier integrates both local line-level and Dante audio inputs, ensuring flexible connectivity and superior audio distribution tailored to the acoustics of the space. With its dual power supply capability, sophisticated DSP for custom audio shaping, and intelligent IO detection for seamless paging integration, the AMP-260-DNT stands as an indispensable tool in professional AV setups.

The AMP-260-DNT supports both local line-level and remote Dante audio inputs, allowing for a wide range of audio sources to be connected. This flexibility ensures that the amplifier can seamlessly integrate into any existing AV infrastructure, providing high-quality audio distribution across different zones.

Equipped with a comprehensive digital signal processor (DSP), this amplifier offers extensive audio customization options including gain control, a limiter, five-band EQ, and up to 200ms of delay. These features enable users to fine-tune the audio output to match the specific requirements of the environment, ensuring an optimal listening experience.

With the capability to be powered either by a DC 24V 5A power supply or via PoE+, the AMP-260-DNT offers unmatched operational flexibility. This dual power supply feature ensures that the amplifier can be easily installed and powered in a variety of settings, making it a versatile choice for different professional AV applications.

The amplifier is designed with user convenience in mind, featuring front panel volume controls and LED status indicators for easy operation. Moreover, it adheres to CA SB-327 compliance for secure web UI login controls, ensuring that system settings are protected and can be safely managed either locally or remotely.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The APO-100-UC is the entry level solution in the Apollo series of unified communication products. The APO-100 is designed for small meeting rooms and huddle spaces. Simply connect the included USB cable to any laptop and instantly have access to a premium conference speakerphone, no drivers or software required. The APO-100 also allows video passthrough via USB. The supplied USB-C cable can be used natively with USB-C equipped devices, or with a standard USB-A 3.0 port using Display Link technology. Use the capacitive touch buttons on the top of the speakerphone to control volume, mute the microphone and even mute the video from your laptop, tablet, or smart phone.

All Apollo series products feature a premium 360° omni-directional microphone array with echo cancellation, ensuring you can be heard loud and clear in every meeting. The powerful 10-watt speaker provides crystal clear audio delivery, even in the largest rooms.
Display Link technology allows the USB-C connection to support both native USB-C source devices and standard USB-A connections from laptops for video transmission and data.

Intuitive capacitive touch buttons provide volume control, mic mute, and video mute for your meeting. An LED ring on the top of the speakerphone provides real-time feedback of volume level and mute status.

The APO-210-UC is the premium solution in the Apollo series of unified communication products. The APO-210 is a conference speakerphone and presentation switcher wrapped into one package. With a broad range of connectivity options, transmit video via local USB-C or HDMI, wirelessly with Miracast or AirPlay. Multiview capability allows up to two devices to share content simultaneously, promoting improved collaboration. An integrated USB 3.0 device port allows easy connection of peripheral equipment such as PTZ cameras . The APO-210 adds a HDBaseT output in addition to the HDMI out to support dual-screen meeting spaces.
Loaded with connectivity, the APO-200 & 210 support local connection via USB-C and HDMI, wireless casting via Miracast and AirPlay or casting from our APO-DG1 wireless dongle.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The Apollo VX20 is part of the family of Unified Communication Apollo solutions. The VX20 is a premium conference video bar that integrates a video switcher, speakerphone, and camera into one device. Ready for today’s demanding and versatile meeting spaces, the VX20 comes feature packed with HDMI & USB-C local inputs along with the ability to wireless casting from Airplay and Miracast capable devices. The 4K camera provides enhanced features including presenter tracking and AI assisted lighting. The powerful stereo speakers provide room-filling sound with exceptional bass response for a clear and accurate audio experience.

Features 4 x MEMS microphones in a Beamforming array with Acoustic Echo Cancellation, Automatic Gain Control and Automatic Noise Suppression, ensuring you can be heard loud and clear in every meeting up to 8 meters away. The stereo speakers with bass enhancement provide crisp audio delivery, even in the largest rooms.

The integrated 4K camera not only provides a crystal-clear video conference experience but delivers smart AI enhanced functionality including intelligent backlighting, auto-framing, presenter tracking and speaker tracking.

Compatible with all major meeting software including Microsoft Teams, Zoom, WebEx, BlueJeans and many more. No matter what you or your company use to collaborate, the VX20 provides the fundamental connectivity to have a successful meeting.

Add on the APO-COM-MIC USB microphone for expanded pickup range in your meeting space. This microphone features a 360 degree pick-up angle at a distance up to 5m (16ft). Cascade up to 5 mics and ensure even the largest rooms are fully covered.

The APO-DG1 features an incredibly easy to use experience. Compatible with any USB-C laptop, simply connect the dongle to an available USB-C port and then tap the button to begin sharing your desktop. No more confusing or complicated connections required.
Native USB-C connection provides up to 60w device charging for laptops or tablets

checks: The v2 product page claims compatibility with Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR), e.g. Lenovo ThinkSmart Core Gen 1/2. This is a compatibility claim, not a certification statement - confirm Teams Rooms certification status and test the room before install when quoting a Teams deployment.

The camera is ePTZ (digital), not mechanical PTZ, with a fixed-focus lens. Confirm this suits the room rather than assuming optical zoom.
warnings: The HDMI input supports HDCP 1.4 only. A protected 4K source requiring HDCP 2.2 will not pass through it.
Input and output maxima differ. It is easy to quote this as a '4K60 bar' when only one output reaches 4K60 and no input does.

sourceCatalog.quoteWarnings: The v2 product page claims compatibility with Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR), e.g. Lenovo ThinkSmart Core Gen 1/2. This is a compatibility claim, not a certification statement - confirm Teams Rooms certification status and test the room before install when quoting a Teams deployment. Inputs are capped at 4K@30Hz, and the HDMI input is HDCP 1.4 only. Confirm before quoting against a 4K60 or HDCP 2.2 source requirement. The two HDMI outputs are not equivalent - output 1 is 4K@60 HDCP 2.3, output 2 is 4K@30 HDCP 2.2. Confirm which display is on which. The camera is ePTZ (digital), not mechanical PTZ, with a fixed-focus lens. Confirm this suits the room rather than assuming optical zoom. The HDMI input supports HDCP 1.4 only. A protected 4K source requiring HDCP 2.2 will not pass through it. Input and output maxima differ. It is easy to quote this as a '4K60 bar' when only one output reaches 4K60 and no input does.

evidence: Bringing the wealth of knowledge that WyreStorm has accumulated in hybrid HDMI cables, the DAOC brings the same powerful benefits to DisplayPort system topology. Connecting to PC graphics cards or high performance media playback systems, the DAOC is ready for content up to 8K/60 at 8-bit 4:4:4 plus support for HDR-10. The WyreStorm DAOC can extend super high-bandwidth video with up to 32 channels of PCM audio up to 10m/33ft using the very latest in active optical transmission technology.

The next big thing in video timings, although seldom seen in consumer electronics, is an established format in the professional display & signage markets. The WyreStorm DAOC cables are compatible with content running at 8K (7680 x 4320) 30Hz natively or 8K 60Hz utilizing DSC (Display Stream Compression). HDR10 content is also supported between compatible devices.

Usually adopted for use in powerful HDBaseT Extenders such as WyreStorm's EX-100-H2-PRO, the VESA approved Display Stream Compression technology is now being used in native HDMI connections for the first time. The aim is to send super-high bandwidth content at a lower transmission data-rate using this mathematically lossless compression algorithm; the WyreStorm FRL HAOC cables are compatible with this technology and will safely pass the signal from source to display.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, DisplayPort technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible "metadata" in both directions and it's this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, EDID and HDCP are all supported by WyreStorm DAOC cables.

featureLines: 32Gbps 8K 60Hz DisplayPort 1.4 Active Optical Cable with DP++ Support (10m/32ft) Plenum, FT6 Approvals - WyreStorm
WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.
32Gbps 8K 60Hz DisplayPort 1.4 Active Optical Cable with DP++ Support (10m/32ft) Plenum, FT6 Approvals

Bringing the wealth of knowledge that WyreStorm has accumulated in hybrid HDMI cables, the DAOC brings the same powerful benefits to DisplayPort system topology. Connecting to PC graphics cards or high performance media playback systems, the DAOC is ready for content up to 8K/60 at 8-bit 4:4:4 plus support for HDR-10. The WyreStorm DAOC can extend super high-bandwidth video with up to 32 channels of PCM audio up to 10m/33ft using the very latest in active optical transmission technology.

The next big thing in video timings, although seldom seen in consumer electronics, is an established format in the professional display & signage markets. The WyreStorm DAOC cables are compatible with content running at 8K (7680 x 4320) 30Hz natively or 8K 60Hz utilising DSC (Display Stream Compression). HDR10 content is also supported between compatible devices.

Usually adopted for use in powerful HDBaseT Extenders such as WyreStorm's EX-100-H2-PRO, the VESA approved Display Stream Compression technology is now being used in native HDMI connections for the first time. The aim is to send super-high bandwidth content at a lower transmission data-rate using this mathematically lossless compression algorithm; the WyreStorm FRL HAOC cables are compatible with this technology and will safely pass the signal from source to display.

Adopting a powerful 4-core transmission system, the passive optical conversion within the WyreStorm DAOC cables is compatible with new content, meeting the current DP1.4 standard. With each core rated at 8.1Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the DAOC will support current & future content up to 32.4Gbps, equating to 8K/60 4:4:4 using peer-to-peer DSC.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, DisplayPort technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible "metadata" in both directions and it's this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, EDID and HDCP are all supported by WyreStorm DAOC cables.

evidence: The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K and 5K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication, thanks to their ability to be a passive communication technology compared to normal HDBaseT extenders that often terminate the HDMI signal prior to transmission.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. With each core rated at 6Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible "metadata" in both directions and it's this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC's.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K and 5K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication, thanks to their ability to be a passive communication technology compared to normal HDBaseT extenders that often terminate the HDMI signal prior to transmission.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. With each core rated at 6Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible "metadata" in both directions and it's this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC's.

The emergence of HDR has inevitably meant there are several methods of displaying deeper colour palettes. Open standards such as HDR-10 & HLG and licensed versions like Dolby Vision & SL-HDR1 are all currently competing formats that all vary in their method of effectively achieving the same end result. WyreStorm HAOC's, being a transparent transmission medium, support all known HDR standards and send them uncompressed.

evidence: The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K and 5K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication. This model features a detachable RX head and is certified for fire safety.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. With each core rated at 6Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible "metadata" in both directions and it's this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC's.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K and 5K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication. This model features a detachable RX head and is certified for fire safety.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. With each core rated at 6Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible "metadata" in both directions and it's this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC's.

The emergence of HDR has inevitably meant there are several methods of displaying deeper colour palettes. Open standards such as HDR-10 & HLG and licensed versions like Dolby Vision & SL-HDR1 are all currently competing formats that all vary in their method of effectively achieving the same end result. WyreStorm HAOC's, being a transparent transmission medium, support all known HDR standards and send them uncompressed.

With each core rated at 6Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible "metadata" in both directions and it's this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC's.

The emergence of HDR has inevitably meant there are several methods of displaying deeper colour palettes. Open standards such as HDR-10 & HLG and licensed versions like Dolby Vision & SL-HDR1 are all currently competing formats that all vary in their method of effectively achieving the same end result. WyreStorm HAOC's, being a transparent transmission medium, support all known HDR standards and send them uncompressed.

evidence: The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K and 5K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication, thanks to their ability to be a passive communication technology compared to normal HDBaseT extenders that often terminate the HDMI signal prior to transmission.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. With each core rated at 6Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible "metadata" in both directions and it's this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC's.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K and 5K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication, thanks to their ability to be a passive communication technology compared to normal HDBaseT extenders that often terminate the HDMI signal prior to transmission.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. With each core rated at 6Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible "metadata" in both directions and it's this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC's.

The emergence of HDR has inevitably meant there are several methods of displaying deeper colour palettes. Open standards such as HDR-10 & HLG and licensed versions like Dolby Vision & SL-HDR1 are all currently competing formats that all vary in their method of effectively achieving the same end result. WyreStorm HAOC's, being a transparent transmission medium, support all known HDR standards and send them uncompressed.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K and 5K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication. This model features a detachable RX head and is certified for fire safety.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. With each core rated at 6Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible "metadata" in both directions and it's this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC's.

The emergence of HDR has inevitably meant there are several methods of displaying deeper colour palettes. Open standards such as HDR-10 & HLG and licensed versions like Dolby Vision & SL-HDR1 are all currently competing formats that all vary in their method of effectively achieving the same end result. WyreStorm HAOC's, being a transparent transmission medium, support all known HDR standards and send them uncompressed.

evidence: The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K and 5K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication. This model features a detachable RX head and is certified for fire safety.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. With each core rated at 6Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible "metadata" in both directions and it's this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC's.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K and 5K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication. This model features a detachable RX head and is certified for fire safety.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. With each core rated at 6Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible "metadata" in both directions and it's this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC's.

The emergence of HDR has inevitably meant there are several methods of displaying deeper colour palettes. Open standards such as HDR-10 & HLG and licensed versions like Dolby Vision & SL-HDR1 are all currently competing formats that all vary in their method of effectively achieving the same end result. WyreStorm HAOC's, being a transparent transmission medium, support all known HDR standards and send them uncompressed.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K and 5K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication. This model features a detachable RX head and is certified for fire safety.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. With each core rated at 6Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible "metadata" in both directions and it's this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC's.

The emergence of HDR has inevitably meant there are several methods of displaying deeper colour palettes. Open standards such as HDR-10 & HLG and licensed versions like Dolby Vision & SL-HDR1 are all currently competing formats that all vary in their method of effectively achieving the same end result. WyreStorm HAOC's, being a transparent transmission medium, support all known HDR standards and send them uncompressed.

evidence: The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication, thanks to their ability to be a passive communication technology compared to normal HDBaseT TM extenders that often terminate the HDMI signal prior to transmission.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the EXP-CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. The EXP-CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication, thanks to their ability to be a passive communication technology compared to normal HDBaseT TM extenders that often terminate the HDMI signal prior to transmission.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the EXP-CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. The EXP-CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC's.

Open standards such as HDR-10 & HLG and licensed versions like Dolby Vision & Advanced HDR (Technicolor) are all competing formats that all vary in their method of effectively achieving the same end result. WyreStorm HAOC's, being a transparent transmission medium, support all known HDR standards and send them uncompressed.
Compatible with all current and emerging HDR standards at up to 60Hz:
True native HDMI communication ensures CEC and ARC communication between compatible devices
Supports emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) and VRR (Variable Refresh Rate)

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication, thanks to their ability to be a passive communication technology compared to normal HDBaseT TM extenders that often terminate the HDMI signal prior to transmission.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the EXP-CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. The EXP-CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It's not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC's.

Open standards such as HDR-10 & HLG and licensed versions like Dolby Vision & Advanced HDR (Technicolor) are all competing formats that all vary in their method of effectively achieving the same end result. WyreStorm HAOC's, being a transparent transmission medium, support all known HDR standards and send them uncompressed.
Compatible with all current and emerging HDR standards at up to 60Hz:
True native HDMI communication ensures CEC and ARC communication between compatible devices
Supports emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) and VRR (Variable Refresh Rate)
4K HDR 4:4:4 60Hz HDMI 1x4 Splitter with 1080p Scaling Feature
4K HDR 4:4:4 60Hz HDMI 1x2 Splitter with 1080p Scaling Feature
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

1x CAB-HAOC-FRL-10 or CAB-HAOC-FRL-15 Active Optical HDMI Cable

The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 8K and 4K HDR content. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication, thanks to their ability to be a passive communication technology compared to HDBaseT extenders that often terminate the HDMI signal prior to transmission. Looking ahead to the next generation of content crossing into the HDMI2.1 specification, WyreStorm FRL hybrid optical HDMI cables have been designed ready for both content available now and that of the future.

8K and high framerate 4K HDR up to 48Gbps and new HDR standards such as SL-HDR1 and PQ are supported using the latest optical transmission technology. Additionally they offer a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate).

Usually adopted for use in powerful HDBaseT Extenders such as WyreStorm’s EX-100-H2-PRO, the VESA approved Display Stream Compression technology is now being used in native HDMI connections for the first time. The aim is to send super-high bandwidth content at a lower transmission data-rate using this mathematically lossless compression algorithm; the WyreStorm FRL HAOC cables are compatible with this technology and will safely pass the signal from source to display.

Adopting a powerful 48Gbps 4-core transmission system, the passive optical transmission within these FRL cables is compatible with new content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. With each core rated at 12Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC-FRL will support future content up to 48Gbps, equating to 8K/60 4:4:4 using peer-to-peer DSC.

It’s not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible “metadata” in both directions and it’s this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. eARC, CEC, ALLM, and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC-FRL cables.

Ready for future HDCP 2.3 content encryption

Supports emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) and VRR (Variable Refresh Rate)

The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K and 5K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication, thanks to their ability to be a passive communication technology compared to normal HDBaseT extenders that often terminate the HDMI signal prior to transmission.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. With each core rated at 6Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It’s not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible “metadata” in both directions and it’s this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC’s.

The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K and 5K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication, thanks to their ability to be a passive communication technology compared to normal HDBaseT extenders that often terminate the HDMI signal prior to transmission.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. With each core rated at 6Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It’s not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible “metadata” in both directions and it’s this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. The emergence of HDR has inevitably meant there are several methods of displaying deeper colour palettes. Open standards such as HDR-10 & HLG and licensed versions like Dolby Vision & SL-HDR1 are all currently competing formats that all vary in their method of effectively achieving the same end result. WyreStorm HAOC’s, being a transparent transmission medium, support all known HDR standards and send them uncompressed.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm HAOC is a next generation HDMI cable designed for the next generation of 4K and 5K HDR content. It offers a unique feature set in both delivering uncompressed HDMI content at up to 24Gbps and compatibility with emerging HDMI technologies such as ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) & VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) using the latest in optical transmission technology. Now established as the most powerful form of HDMI extension, WyreStorm active optical cables offer the best of both worlds: pixel-perfect long distance transmission of content and native HDMI communication. This model features a detachable RX head and is certified for fire safety.

Using a 4-core transmission system and passive optical transmission, the CAB-HAOC cables are compatible with content exceeding the current HDMI 2.0 standard. With each core rated at 6Gbps, the combined bandwidth means that the CAB-HAOC will support future content up to 24Gbps, equating to 4K/60 4:4:4 10-bit. Emerging resolutions in gaming are also supported, such as 2560x1440p @144Hz.

It’s not all about raw bandwidth and transmission power, HDMI technology works by sending huge amounts of invisible “metadata” in both directions and it’s this information that makes or breaks a viewing experience. WyreStorm Active Optical Cables have been verified to not only ensure that the A/V signal gets to its destination but also the invisible metadata too. CEC, ARC, ALLM and VRR are all supported by WyreStorm HAOC’s.

The emergence of HDR has inevitably meant there are several methods of displaying deeper colour palettes. Open standards such as HDR-10 & HLG and licensed versions like Dolby Vision & SL-HDR1 are all currently competing formats that all vary in their method of effectively achieving the same end result. WyreStorm HAOC’s, being a transparent transmission medium, support all known HDR standards and send them uncompressed.

The USB Type A Female connector allows universal compatibility with almost any USB device. Just simply connect the USB cable that came with your device to the CAB-UAOC-15 and you are up and running. No software or drivers required.
Supporting the USB 3.2 Gen 2 specification, send A/V or data signals at up to 10Gbps. That's equivalent to transferring a 10Gb file in 8 seconds.
Plenum, FT6 & CPR safety ratings allow the CAB-UAOC-15 to be installed in air plenums, ducts, walls, conduits, ceilings, or anywhere else a fire rating is required.
Supports USB 3.2 Gen 2 spec allowing up to 10Gbps bandwidth
Compatible with USB 3.0 hubs to allow connection of multiple USB devices (combined power consumption of devices cannot exceed 5v 900mA)
Backwards compatible with USB 2.0 specification

The CAM-0402-BRG is a compact and powerful 4K multi-camera video bridge designed to simplify video switching and integration for conferencing, streaming, recording, and hybrid events. Supporting up to four wired inputs (2x HDMI, 2x USB), this device delivers a unified video output via USB or HDMI — all in stunning 4K resolution.

Seamlessly mix up to eight video sources from a variety of formats — including 2 HDMI inputs and 2 USB 3.0 UVC cameras. This versatility allows users to combine local and remote sources in a single workflow, making it ideal for hybrid meetings, training sessions, and multi-angle streaming productions.

Seamlessly mix up to eight video sources from a variety of formats — including 2 HDMI inputs, 2 USB 3.0 UVC cameras, and 4 NDI streams over the network. This versatility allows users to combine local and remote sources in a single workflow, making it ideal for hybrid meetings, training sessions, and multi-angle streaming productions.

The CAM-0402-BRG delivers a unified video output through USB (UVC) and HDMI simultaneously. Whether you need a clean single view or a multiview layout with up to four sources on-screen at once, this device offers maximum flexibility for streaming, local display, and remote contribution — all in up to 4K resolution.

The CAM-0402-NDI-BRG delivers a unified video output through USB (UVC), HDMI, and NDI simultaneously. Whether you need a clean single view or a multiview layout with up to four sources on-screen at once, this device offers maximum flexibility for streaming, local display, and remote contribution — all in up to 4K resolution.

The USB HOST output appears as a standard UVC/UAC webcam, making it instantly recognized by any video conferencing or recording platform without additional drivers. Compatible with Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, OBS, vMix, and more — it's the easiest way to bring multiple camera feeds into your workflow..

sourceCatalog.quoteWarnings: The 4x MEMS mic array is explicitly documented as unusable as a video conference audio source - it exists for voice detection and audio tracking. Always quote a separate conference microphone. Maximum is 4K@30fps, not 4K@60. Confirm against any 4K60 requirement. Rotation is +/-75 degrees horizontal, far less than a conventional PTZ. Confirm the coverage suits the room. It is easy to assume the built-in mic array covers room audio. The datasheet states it cannot be used as a conference audio source. Quoting this camera as the room's microphone would be wrong. Pan range is limited compared with a traditional PTZ camera; this is a fixed dual-lens AI design, not a full-rotation PTZ.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Bringing the latest technology currently only seen on the latest HDMI 2.1 devices the CON-H2-DD-EARC tackles the demands of today's technology head-on and provides a multi-pronged approach to the challenges of the modern residential AV system. It combines a powerful set of features that can both down-mix Dolby TrueHD or DTS-HD audio to stereo and scale incoming 4K UHD content to 1080p. The DSP-controlled stereo audio output allows adjustment of both volume and EQ via a control system and the unit can be customized further by manually controlling the down-mixing to the S/PDIF and HDMI outputs. ARC/eARC breakout of audio from a connected smart TV completes the formidable line-up of this trail-blazing device.

With an 18Gbps HDMI input the CON-H2-DD-EARC supports video content up to 4K/60 4:4:4. Compatibility with the latest 4K specifications such as HDR10 and Dolby Vision ensures maximum video fidelity no matter the source you connect.

Powerful audio capabilities allow up to 7.1 Dolby True HD and DTS-HD signals to be downmixed to stereo RCA for multi-zone amplifiers. A built-in DSP allows for the audio level and EQ to be adjusted for the stereo RCA output.

Easily send audio from apps on your Smart TV with support for Audio Return Channel. Take it a step further with eARC. With support for Enhanced Audio Return Channel, you can now send 7.1 audio directly from your TV and downmix or de-embed into an external audio system.
With maximizing compatibility in mind, the CON-H2-DD-EARC's HDMI output features a powerful scaler. Seamlessly connect a 4K HDR source and scale to 1080p if connecting to an older display.
Support for ARC (Audio Return Channel) and eARC (Enhanced Audio Return Channel) through HDMI to de-embed or downmix audio from smart displays
Supports rack mounting with the NHD-000-RACK4 or NHD-140-RACK-1U.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Whether the requirement is to scale to or from the full capacity of HDMI2.0, the CON-H2-SCL allows incoming content to be converted (stripping HDR metadata if necessary) to a format compatible with the connected display or projector.

Compatible with any current content thanks to its 18Gbps and HDCP2.2 support, it can be placed in-line after any source device and extract the incoming audio via the 3.5mm jack or coaxial S/PDIF port.

The EX-100-H2 uses the powerful HDBaseT 2.0 chipset to send along 4K, USB, PoH and HD audio up to 100m/328ft with a single Cat 6 cable. This extender hosts the perfect combination of features to give you the tools you need to set up your next conference or presentation. With separate audio lanes, you’re free to send audio independently to overlay your presentation.

Equipped with the HDMI USB extender 2.0 spec, the EX-100-H2 not only provides KVM functionality for extension of keyboard/mouse or touchscreen, but also transfers the highest data rate that HDBaseT has to offer of 190Mbps, for webcams, white boards and USB data drives.

Two separate audio feeds can also be sent bidirectionally, thanks to a dedicated audio pass-through that allows 2ch analog to be sent and received at either end completely independent of the HDMI signal.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Extend 18Gbps A/V signals up to 100 meters with the EX-100-H2-EARC. This extender uses AVX technology, a similar transmission that is found inside our powerful NetworkHD 600 series, to send 4K HDR and Dolby Vision content at 60Hz. Compatible with eARC, you can transmit audio signals such as Dolby TrueHD/Atmos and DTS-HD MA 7.1 signals from a smart TV back to an eARC enabled AVR or soundbar. Flexible control passthrough options including IR, RS-232 and LAN allow you control a display and get devices connected over long distances.
Sporting an 18Gbps HDMI input, the EX-100-H2-EARC can support all UHD video signals up to and including 2160p 4:4:4/60, and high framerate HDR 12bit 4:2:2 up to 60Hz.

Passthrough signals such as IR and RS-232 from a control system to control your display or other AV equipment. The ethernet passthrough supports full 1Gbps speeds for extending internet or LAN connections.

The EX-100-KVM-IP, a top-tier KVM over IP solution, excels in transmitting 4K video at 30Hz with virtually zero latency, making it an essential tool in professional environments. It stands out for its ability to ensure efficient, reliable performance across various settings, including corporate, educational, and specialized AV scenarios. Its advanced features cater to the needs of high-resolution displays and real-time interactions, enhancing the overall user experience in demanding and dynamic professional contexts.

This EX-100-KVM-IP delivers high-definition 4K video quality at a smooth 30 frames per second, coupled with an ultra-fast response time of less than 1 millisecond. This combination is crucial for applications that require both high visual fidelity and real-time interaction, such as video conferencing or dynamic digital signage.
Does the EX-100-KVM-IP support 4K video transmission, and at what frame rates?

Yes. The EX-100-KVM-IP supports 4K video at 3840×2160p and 4096×2160p up to 30Hz (4K@30Hz) with ultra-low latency (<1ms). It also supports 1920×1080p at 60Hz. Maximum pixel clock 300MHz and encoding rate 9Gb/s; HDCP 1.4 supported.

Mount units with the included brackets, connect the HDMI source to the encoder and the HDMI display to the decoder, link the encoder/decoder to a 1G network via RJ-45, connect 12V power, and attach USB peripherals. It’s plug-and-play with zero configuration; use DIP switches for multi-unit setups.
The product page does not explicitly state compatibility with third-party KVM switches. It supports HDMI 1.4b, HDCP 1.4, and USB 2.0 over IP, which are standard interfaces.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

A versatile and powerful solution for extending your USB connectivity. Engineered to support the latest USB 3.2 Gen 1 standard, this extender offers rapid data transfer speeds of up to 5Gbps, ideal for a variety of high-performance USB peripherals. Its four-port design allows for simultaneous connection of multiple devices. With a remarkable capability to extend USB signals up to 100 meters, it ensures reliable, long-distance connectivity.

Equipped with advanced PoH+ (Power over HDBaseT) support, this unit can deliver a substantial 25.5 Watts of power to all connected peripherals. It also features a high-current output specifically designed to efficiently power devices like USB 3.0 cameras, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

It’s features include support for cutting-edge HDMI 2.1 resolutions, delivering 8K@30Hz (or 8K@60Hz 4:2:0) and 4K@120Hz (4:4:4) video up to 35m over a single Cat5e/6 cable, or up to 40m over Cat6a/7, ensuring future-proof performance with a 40Gbps data rate and HDCP 2.3 compliance. Installation is simplified through Bi-direction PoC (Power over Cable), requiring only one power adapter for the entire link, while integrated RS232 and Bi-direction IR Pass-through provide comprehensive control. Furthermore, the unit offers professional audio handling with a balanced de-embedded audio output on the Receiver (RX) for connecting to dedicated sound systems.

IR for source control and PoC all wrapped up in a compact chassis for unbeatable value, reliability and ease of installation.

The latest 4K HDR content arriving via satellite, cable, disc or stream is all heavily encrypted. Being part of the evolving family of extenders, the EXP-EX-35-G2 supports the multi-point distribution of this content over a single category cable.
With features such as PoC, automatic EDID, VLC and IR source control, the EXP-EX-35-G2 brings a tremendous amount of features to any simple installation at a cost effective price.
No two installs are the same; that’s why we‘ve enabled our EXP-EX-35-G2 extender to be powered from either the TX or RX, meaning maximum flexibility on-site without hunting for a mains outlet.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Part of the latest generation of WyreStorm 4K extenders for the latest generation of 4K HDR content, the EX-35-H2 features dynamic compression technology to enable high frame rate HDR-10 and HLG content to be transmitted over standard 10Gbps HDBaseT, both visually losslessly and without latency.

The latest 4K UHD content arriving via satellite, cable, disc or stream is all heavily encrypted. Being part of the H2 product family, the EX-35-H2 supports the multi-point distribution of this content over HDBaseT.
No 2 installs are the same; that’s why we’ve enabled all of the H2 extender line up to be powered from either the TX or RX, meaning maximum flexibility on-site without hunting for a mains outlet.
Full UHD 4K transmission supporting HDMI 2.0 video standards

Supports 2ch PCM and 7.1 multichannel audio up to DTS-X and Dolby Atmos
Threaded bushings allow use of both standard and locking DC power plugs
Energy efficient universal power supply included

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Part of the latest generation of WyreStorm 4K extenders for the latest generation of 4K HDR content, the EX-35-ARC features dynamic compression for delivery of 4K/60 4:4:4 and HDR content up to 17.8Gbps over standard HDBaseT, both visually losslessly and without latency.

With support for HDR-10 and HLG up to 60Hz, and Dolby Vision TM at 30Hz, the EX-35-H2-ARC offers True Audio Return Channel (ARC), enabling an ARC signal from a Smart TV HDMI input to be passed to an AVR HDMI output .

Knowing the speed at which technology moves, at WyreStorm we’re always looking ahead. That’s why we’ve included our VLC chipset (Visually Lossless Compression) in this extender meaning not only ARC is supported but also the next shift in content technology: 60Hz HDR and 4:4:4 60Hz.

With on-demand content forming the new way of watching TV, free the audio from within a SmartTV with the WyreStorm EX-35-H2-ARC HDBaseT TM extender, supporting both True ARC (via HDMI) or optical audio return.

HDR Content has recently enjoyed an up-shift in refresh rates after starting its life at 24Hz on UHD Blu-Ray discs. High frame-rate HDR is now available at 60Hz on certain discs and via games consoles like the Xbox One X; the EX-35-H2-ARC is ready for this, supporting both HDR-10, HLG and Dolby Vision* (*Dolby Vision at up to 30Hz).

Fully-featured audio performance doesn’t stop at the ability to handle ARC, the transmitter of the EX-35-H2-ARC offers the ability to extract 2ch PCM audio from the source via the 3-pin phoenix port for connection to an audio system.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

With the low-profile point-to-point EX-40-G3 extender set, it’s never been easier to extend full 1080p HD video over a Cat6 cable; HD audio is also supported. Plus, IR source control and PoC (Power-over-Cable) all wrapped up in a compact chassis for unbeatable value, reliability and ease of installation.
WyreStorm’s newly designed 40 meter extender, the EX-40-G3, is now smaller than ever. With almost half the width of its predecessor, this makes the G3 lighter in weight and easier to keep discreet.

Size isn’t the only upgrade found in the newly designed 40 meter extender. The G3 now includes Power over Cable abilities, saving the installer time and headache from having to supply local power discreetly to the receiver. But don’t fret if PoC isn’t available, as the receiver is capable of accepting local power.
With features such as PoC, automatic EDID, long cable mode capability and IR source control, the EX-40-G3 brings a tremendous amount of features to any simple installation at a cost effective price.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The EX-40-H2-ARC is a 4K60 4:4:4 HDBaseT 2.0 extender designed for residential applications that demand audio return flexibility. Featuring ARC and S/PDIF pathways from RX to TX and analog audio breakout from the HDMI input, this unit is the perfect fit for installations involving modern TVs and legacy audio systems.
Supports 4K@60Hz 4:4:4 over 40m with full HDR compatibility
Uncompressed HDMI 2.0 video up to 4K@60Hz 4:4:4 over a single Cat6a/7 cable, with support for up to 70m at 1080p
Supports HDMI ARC and S/PDIF audio return from the display to the source
Supports HDR10, HDR10+, HLG, and Dolby Vision (low-latency)
Includes PSU, mounting hardware, IR cables, and Phoenix connectors
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

EX-40-KVM-5K is an HDBT 3.0 extender kit that delivers uncompressed video up to 5K@30Hz and 5120x1440@60Hz, with full support for 4K@60Hz 4:4:4 and all HDR formats. It supports USB 2.0 pass-through with 1x USB-B on TX and 4 x USB-A on RX, making it ideal for KVM applications. Audio features include HDMI audio format support, analog audio pass-through from TX to RX, and de-embedding on both ends. An HDMI loop-out is provided on the TX for local preview. RS-232 port functions are configurable via DIP switch for control signal pass-through and firmware updates.
Supporting ultra-high resolution up to 5K@30Hz (5120x2160) and 5120x1440@60Hz, with full compatibility for 4K@60Hz 4:4:4 8-bit and all HDR formats including HDR10, HLG, Dolby Vision, and HDR10+.

For audio, EX-40-KVM-5K supports full HDMI 2.0 audio formats including Dolby Atmos and DTS:X, while also providing analog audio de-embedding on both TX and RX, as well as one-way analog audio pass-through from TX to RX.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm EX-60-USB2 is a plug-and-play USB 2.0 extender that transmits USB signals up to 60m (196ft) over a single Cat6/6a/7 cable utilizing a direct hardware-based transmission method, eliminating common USB compatibility issues. The EX-60-USB2 also supports one-way PoC (Power over Cable), allowing the transmitter to power the receiver through the same category cable—making installation simple and efficient. It’s an ideal solution for home offices, surveillance setups, and gaming environments, enabling you to extend USB devices such as cameras, speakerphones, and keyboards/mice from a local zone to a remote PC or laptop.

The EX-60-USB2 delivers high-speed data transfer rates of up to 480Mbps. The integrated USB hub allows direct connection of multiple peripherals, streamlining workstation setups and enhancing user convenience in diverse environments—from office workspaces to interactive kiosks.
With 4 USB device ports, it not only provides KVM functionality for extending keyboards, mice, or touchscreens, but also supports full USB data transfer for devices such as cameras and speakerphones.
With one-way PoC power support, simply power the transmitter and the receiver is powered through the category cable—reducing potential points of failure and simplifying installation.
Designed for true plug-and-play operation with zero configuration required, it provides hassle-free setup and immediate use right out of the box, making it exceptionally user-friendly.

The EX-60D-KVM is a dual-display HDMI KVM extender designed to transmit two 1080p video signals and USB peripherals over a single category cable up to 80 meters. Using visually lossless compression, the extender allows dual HDMI displays and USB devices to operate remotely from a central computer while maintaining reliable performance and simplified installation. Ideal for dual-monitor workstations, training environments, and light commercial control applications, the EX-60D-KVM delivers efficient workstation extension using a single-cable infrastructure.

The EX-60D-KVM simultaneously transmits two independent HDMI video streams at up to 1080p60 4:4:4 over a single category cable. This capability makes the extender ideal for dual-monitor workstations, allowing users to maintain their full desktop workspace remotely without compromising performance or requiring additional infrastructure.
Designed for flexible deployment, the EX-60D-KVM extends video and USB signals over standard Cat5e/6/6a/7 cabling.

evidence: The EX-60D-KVM is a dual-display HDMI KVM extender designed to transmit two 1080p video signals and USB peripherals over a single category cable up to 80 meters. Using visually lossless compression, the extender allows dual HDMI displays and USB devices to operate remotely from a central computer while maintaining reliable performance and simplified installation. Ideal for dual-monitor workstations, training environments, and light commercial control applications, the EX-60D-KVM delivers efficient workstation extension using a single-cable infrastructure.
Integrated USB 2.0 KVM Extension for Full Workstation Control

The extender includes a USB 2.0 host connection on the transmitter and four USB device ports on the receiver, enabling remote connection of keyboards, mice, touchscreens, cameras, storage devices, and other peripherals. Supporting USB data rates up to 480 Mbps, the EX-60D-KVM ensures responsive operation of USB devices and seamless remote workstation control, making it well suited for professional computing environments and operator workstations.

The receiver unit powers the transmitter through one-way Power over Cable (PoC), allowing both units to operate from a single power adapter installed at the receiver side. This design simplifies installation, reduces the number of power supplies required in a system, and enables cleaner deployments in equipment racks, workstations, and control environments.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Super-compact HDBaseT extender set capable of transmitting 4K UHD video and HD audio formats up to 35m/115ft of Cat5e cable. Also compatible with HDCP2.2 protected content, the EX-70-G2 has powerful bi-directional pass-through of CEC, IR and RS-232. 2-way PoH means device can be powered from either end for flexible installation options.
We might live in a 4K world, but not every application needs it. Compatible with the latest 4K/60 and 1080p sources alike, the EX-70-G2 delivers whatever content you have, wherever its needed.
Weighing in for the featherweight title at just 15mm thick, the EX-70-G2 can be installed just about anywhere, but still packs the punch to deliver video, audio, control and power like a champ.
Compatible with 2160p 4:2:0 60Hz or 4:4:4 & RGB 30Hz Content
2ch PCM and multichannel audio supported up to DTS:X and Dolby Atmos
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

The EX-70-H2C is a high-performance video distribution solution designed for both residential home theaters and multi-media conference halls, capable of extending full 4K@60Hz (4:4:4) and 18Gbps signals up to 70m (230ft) over a single Cat6/6a cable. It includes an HDMI OUT loop-out on the TX unit for a local monitor, and features essential functionalities like bi-direction IR pass-through for remote device control, bi-direction POC (Power over Cable) for flexible power delivery, and ARC (Audio Return Channel) support with an S/PDIF audio de-embedding port, all packaged in a compact, durable steel chassis.

Includes an HDMI OUT port on the TX unit to connect a local display (loop-out). It also supports ARC (Audio Return Channel), allowing audio from the remote TV to be sent back and de-embedded via the S/PDIF output on the RX unit.

EDID Management: Supports EDID control via a switch on the TX unit, allowing the user to select from fixed resolutions (1080P@60Hz or 4K@60Hz) or copy the EDID from either the TX (source) or RX (display) unit for guaranteed compatibility.

It includes an HDMI OUT loop-out on the TX unit for a local monitor, and features essential functionalities like bi-direction IR pass-through for remote device control, bi-direction POC (Power over Cable) for flexible power delivery, and ARC (Audio Return Channel) support with an S/PDIF audio de-embedding port, all packaged in a compact, durable steel chassis.

Features Power over Cable (POC), meaning only one power supply is needed for either the TX or RX unit, simplifying installation. It also supports bi-direction IR pass-through for controlling source devices from the display location and vice versa.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Extending 4K UHD content at 4:4:4/60 up to 70m/230ft, the EX-70-H2X is compatible with the latest HDR standards including HDR-10 and HLG up to 60Hz; Dolby Vision is supported at 30Hz. Powerful Class A HDBaseT transmission means Ethernet, IR & RS-232 are also supported, with the addition of 2-way PoH for flexible installation options. The HDMI loop-output means that source content can be sent to multiple locations by simply cascading the signal to additional extenders or switchers.

Knowing the speed at which technology moves, at WyreStorm we're always looking ahead. That's why we've included our VLC chipset (Variable Lossless Compression) in this extender meaning seamless support of the next shift in content technology: 4K/60 HDR-10 & HLG and even up to 4:4:4.

HDR Content has recently enjoyed an up-shift in refresh rates after starting its life at 24Hz on UHD Blu-Ray discs. High frame-rate HDR is now available at 60Hz on certain discs and via gaming consoles like the Xbox One X. The EX-70-H2X is now ready to support both HDR-10, HLG at 60Hz and Dolby Vision content up to 30Hz.

Proudly flying the flag for the full Class A HDBaseT TM feature set, the EX-70-H2X levels-up.?Supporting not only HDR video, HD Audio and control, but also allowing Ethernet pass-through and 2-way PoH.?This allows the?extender to?be powered from a single PSU, located at either end.

The source loop-output on the transmitter allows a multitude of system expansion options without the need for an external splitter. The signal can be cascaded to a second or third extender to feed extra screens, to a matrix switcher so it can be made part of a larger system or even sent to a NetworkHD encoder forming a hybrid distribution system.
Compatible with the latest HDR standards, including HDR-10+, HLG content, with support for Dolby Vision TM up to 30Hz ?C Supports all VESA resolutions within the HDMI 2.0 specification
2-way PoH (Power over HDBaseT) enables either transmitter or receiver to be remotely powered by the other unit
2ch PCM audio and multichannel HD audio supports 7.1, DTS-X and Dolby Atmos TM
Note:? Serial control via RS-232 only supported when connected to a compatible HDBaseT transmission device with routable RS-232
Threaded bushings allow use of both standard and locking 18v DC power plugs
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

title: WyreStorm Essentials 80m KVM UTP Extender - WyreStorm

The EXF-10KM-5K Fiber Extender is a high-performance extender based on the SDVoE solution, specifically designed to transmit uncompressed 5120x1440p video and high-fidelity audio up to 10 kilometers (10KM) over a 10G fiber link. Its key advantage is zero end-to-end latency (<120mu s), which is critical for real-time applications, combined with robust support for HDMI 2.0 and HDCP 2.2 standards, including high frame rates (up to 240Hz for 1080p). Built from durable sheet steel with secure screw-lock power connectors, this system ensures professional-grade reliability and pristine signal quality, making it an ideal choice for extending demanding video sources over long distances without any loss in fidelity or speed.

The product is based on the SDVoE solution and supports the highest quality video format, including 5120 x 2160p 4:2:0 or 4K@60Hz with full 4:4:4 color space and High Dynamic Range (HDR10, HDR10+, HLG, and Dolby Vision low latency mode).

Utilizing the included 10G SFP+ single-mode optical transceivers, the extender is capable of sending the full-fidelity signal up to 10 kilometers (10KM) over fiber, far exceeding the distance limitations of copper HDMI cables.

The extender supports high-end audio formats, including LPCM (up to 7.1 channel/192kHz), Dolby True HD, and DTS-HD Master. Furthermore, it ensures perfect compatibility by passing the display's EDID to the video source transparently.

WyreStorm’s first fiber-optical extender, ensuring perfect transmission of 18Gbps HDMI signals to 300m/984ft. featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm EXP-CON-DAC-D is a Digital to analogue audio converter capable of taking up S/PDIF audio encoded as Dolby Digital 5.1 from a compatible coaxial or TOSLINK audio source and downmixing to analogue stereo. Additionally the switchable digital output allows the signal to be output in its original form or downmixed like the stereo RCA output.

With installation flexibility in mind, the EXP-CON-DAC-D can be powered using the included 5v DC power supply (with included regional pin adaptors) or use the USB power cable to power the DAC-D from a USB power or peripheral port on a third party device, potentially saving a mains outlet.
Supports up to 6 channels of audio encoded as Dolby Digital 5.1
Supports I/O conversion of Toslink-Coaxial or Coaxial-Toslink
Powered by 5v (Mains PSU and USB power cable included)
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

WyreStorm has done the hard part for you because all of our Essentials HDMI cables have been through our grueling testing process. Furthermore, all of our H2 cables are compatible with the latest 4K HDR 18Gbps content to ensure continued compatibility with current & future sources alike.
Compatible with all current and emerging HDR standards at up to 60Hz:-HLG (Hybrid Log Gamma)-HDR-10 and HDR-10+Dolby VisionPQ (Perceptual Quantizer)SL-HDR-1
ARC and CEC compatible for true native HDMI communication
Support of passive HDMI communication standards such as ALLM and VRR

A vast upgrade from its predecessor, the EXP-MX-0402-H2 takes the EXP-MX0402-010 features to new heights, whilst maintaining its cost effect platform. Keeping up with the latest standards, the EXP-MX-0402-H2 has been upgraded to an 18Gbps backbone with HDCP 2.2 compliance and now featuring a powerful built-in auto scaler on both of its outputs allowing users to simultaneously connect a mix of 4K and 1080p displays.

If that wasn’t enough, the EXP-MX-0402-H2 also includes analog and digital audio de-embed and ARC, as well as CEC triggering and RS-232 control, hosting a boat load of control features. Coupled with the WyreStorm TS-280 touchscreen and HAOC line of HDMI cables makes for the perfect power pack solution for mid to large scale residential and light commercial applications!

Aside from the front panel pushbuttons and IR, the EXP-MX-0402-H2 is now equipped with powerful API for RS-232 control. This API gives the user access to advanced functions not typically found in this price range, which include video control, audio mute, CEC triggering EDID settings and basic troubleshooting, just to name a few. Coupled with the TS-280, it makes control a breeze!

The EXP-MX-0402-H2 has the best of not only video in mind, but audio as well. Built to supply any sound system, the EXP-MX-0402-H2 can output analog audio to an amp or speaker system and 5.1 audio to an AVR. Furthermore, a gear selector on output 2 allows ARC to travel back from a smart display to a soundbar or AVR for the best audio and video experience possible!

Sporting an 18Gbps HDMI backplane, the EXP-MX-0402-H2 shares big brother bandwidths, supporting all UHD video signals up to and including 2160p 4:4:4/60, and high frame-rate HDR 12bit 4:2:2 up to 60Hz, along with multichannel audio up to DTS:X and Dolby Atmos.
