featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm EXP-MX-0404-H2 is a powerful plug and play 4K matrix switcher solution. With 18Gbps pure HDMI support, the EXP-MX-404-H2 allows up to four UHD 4K sources to be independently routed to four UHD displays. Each Output has the capability to scale 4K content down to connected 1080p displays without affecting the 4K source.

Furthermore, source audio breakout via digital coax supports to 5.1, which can be sent to an AVR for audio distribution. Additionally, the EXP-MX-0404-H2 boasts an enhance API, giving the user full control over RS-232 or IP. Lastly, the EXP-MX-0404-H2 supports automatic and time delayed CEC, powering displays on when a new source is detected and off when source sink isn't present, making the EXP-MX-0404-H2 a powerful, complete solution.

Like the EXP-MX-0402-H2, all outputs of the EXP-MX-0404-H2's are built with an effective scaler, taking in a 4K signal and downscales the content to 1080p, allowing a mix of 4K and 1080p screens to both show at their highest potential without affecting HDMI handshake or 4K source.

In addition to the control features found in the EXP-MX-0402-H2, the EXP-MX-0404-H2 adds access to its API via LAN. Equipped with an AutoIP function, the EXP-MX-0404-H2 can connect to a DHCP server and be issued an IP address, but if one is not available, it can be reached with its predefined IP address, saving a user time and frustration.

Sporting an 18Gbps HDMI backplane, the EXP-MX-0404-H2 supports all UHD video signals up to and including 2160p 4:4:4/60, and high frame-rate HDR 12bit 4:2:2 up to 60Hz, along with multichannel audio up to DTS:X and Dolby Atmos.
Supports 4K@60Hz 10bit 4:2:0 | 4:4:4 and HDR@24Hz 10bit BT.2020
Each HDMI output supports scaling down to 1080p without affecting 4K source content
Supports coaxial S/PDIF audio de-embed from all outputs.
Support of timed CEC trigger and time delay on both outputs when input is not detected on selected output.
Enhanced API offeres an abundance of control features such as video switching, audio mute of discrete audio outputs, CEC trigger and time delay, EDID control and many troubleshooting options
Supports 12-bit Deep Color, 3D, Lip Sync and loss-less HD audio formats pass through

Our EXP-SP-0102-8K packs a punch as it is a powerful plug-and-play 8K HDMI splitter that has the ability to send uncompressed up to 8K@60Hz or 4K@120Hz up to two displays, but the most useful feature of this splitter is that the second output can scale content down from either 8K>4K or 4K>1080p! Furthermore, its compatible with DSC (Display Stream Compression) version 1.2a pass-through, an approved method of compression in accordance to the HDMI 2.1 specification, allowing up to a lossless 10K@120Hz signal to be transmitted.

The WyreStorm Essentials 8K splitter is the perfect addition to the modern home AV install that includes a powerful 8K display. Split captivating brand new 8K source content to another display in any home entertainment, or media room application. Downscaling allows the content to be split to a second display even if the display resolution isn't as high as the source content.

As early adopters of 4K and 8K signal distribution, we know that retrofitting is important in the dawn of new resolution standards. With our splitter, you can rest assured that you won't be forced to upgrade all displays or AVRs to 8K to reap its benefits. Just set the splitter to downscale to 4K and enjoy 8K content while supporting 4K at the same time!

Display compatibility is the last thing you need to worry about. Our splitter gives you 5 EDIDs that can be adjusted via dipswitches. The splitter also supports Smart EDID, which will auto-negotiate EDIDs based on the detected displays and adjust accordingly.

A true plug-and-play HDMI switcher, supporting up to four 4K HDR sources to one screen

The WyreStorm EXP-SW-0401-H2 is a powerful plug-and-play 4K switcher solution. With up to 18Gbps pure HDMI support, which allows up to four 4K HDR sources to be routed to a single display. The EXP-SW-0401-H2 is capable of auto switching, giving the user the convenience of simply turning on their favorite device without the requiring manual intervention. Furthermore, the EXP-SW-0401-H2 is equipped with signal compensation, allowing an extender or splitter to connect to its output without degrading or delaying the signal.

A trend you may notice is the plug-and-play features WyreStorm’s Essentials product line possesses and it doesn’t stop at our switchers. You can find the same auto EDID and HDCP negotiation found in other Essentials products, but specifically signal regeneration is what makes WyreStorm’s Essentials switchers the king of plug-and-play!

While the EXP-SW-0401-H2 is a stand-alone device, sometimes wiring to the display is too long for a standard HDMI cable, or maybe there are additional displays added. Because of its signal regeneration feature, additional devices can be connected to the output of the switch, like an extender set or splitter, all without signal delay or degradation.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm EXP-SW-0401-H2 is a powerful plug-and-play 4K switcher solution. With up to 18Gbps pure HDMI support, which allows up to four 4K HDR sources to be routed to a single display. The EXP-SW-0401-H2 is capable of auto switching, giving the user the convenience of simply turning on their favorite device without the requiring manual intervention. Furthermore, the EXP-SW-0401-H2 is equipped with signal compensation, allowing an extender or splitter to connect to its output without degrading or delaying the signal.
WyreStorm’s Essentials line of switchers follows the last in first out rule when it comes to auto-switching, making this a convenient feature when a new source is introduced.

A trend you may notice is the plug-and-play features WyreStorm’s Essentials product line possesses and it doesn’t stop at our switchers. You can find the same auto EDID and HDCP negotiation found in other Essentials products, but specifically signal regeneration is what makes WyreStorm’s Essentials switchers the king of plug-and-play!

While the EXP-SW-0401-H2 is a stand-alone device, sometimes wiring to the display is too long for a standard HDMI cable, or maybe there are additional displays added. Because of its signal regeneration feature, additional devices can be connected to the output of the switch, like an extender set or splitter, all without signal delay or degradation.

FOCUS 200 webcam can stream 4K ultra HD video at 30fps, 1080P full HD at 60fps and 720P at 90fps, delivering outstanding clarity, ultra-smoothness and tiny details even in high refresh rate. It is your perfect choice when you need to live stream and record your gameplay or quick movements.

As it is designed with 106° wide-angle lens featuring a wide depth of field (DOF), it can render everything in a scene in focus. featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

HALO 30 USB speakerphone supports acoustic echo cancellation, active background noise reduction and voice enhancement. Its outstanding audio quality can ensure everyone is heard during conference calls, making your meeting more efficient.

HALO 30 speakerphone features a 2W speaker, which can cover any space of a 20?O meeting room, so you won't miss a word. Furthermore, the AGC technology balances out voice volume in real-time to ensure no one sounds too close or too far away from it.

The full-duplex design allows conversations to flow just as they do in person. Especially in a multi-person video conference, the conversations from every side are transmitted naturally and clearly at the same time. It ensures effective communication and improves teamwork efficiency.

HALO 30 speakerphone is compatible with all leading UC platforms, like Zoom, Skype, Teams, WebEx, etc. You can easily connect with colleagues around the world for a seamless meeting experience, whatever platform you‘re using.

HALO 30 speakerphone is also compatible with various operating systems, including Mac OS, Windows 7/8/10/11, Android and iOS. Connect it to your computer via USB cable and you can make a conference call just in a few seconds.
1. What are the main features of HALO 30 speakerphone?

HALO 30 USB conference speakerphone is built with four noise-cancelling mics and a premium speaker. It can pick up sounds from every angle of your meeting space and ensure everyone is heard. It boasts superior sound quality, 360° voice pickup, plug-n-play feature and portable design, ideal for both home office and meeting room of 2 to 4 people.

You can choose HALO 90 conference speakerphone. It integrates speakerphone and USB docking station into one device. It is designed with two USB-A ports, two USB-C ports and an HDMI output port. You can connect your keyboard, mouse, webcam and monitor to it.

HALO 30 only supports wired connection, while HALO 60 supports both wired and Bluetooth connection. On the basis of HALO 30, HALO 90 integrates speakerphone and USB-C docking station into one device, offering an all-in-one solution.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Stay productive in your home office or meeting room with HALO 90 multi-functional speakerphone. It is integrated with HDMI, USB-C and USB-A ports, offering you a variety of connectivity options as well as great conferencing convenience. Just connect HALO 90 to your PC via a single USB-C cable, and you can easily charge your PC while also connecting it to a display, a keyboard and a mouse, plus get on a conference call - all at the same time.

Designed with the latest dual USB 3.2 type-A interface, HALO 90 speakerphone supports up to 10Gbps lightning-speed data transmission. You can connect a 4K camera or ultra-high-speed SSD device, and transfer large media files in seconds via its USB ports.

HALO 90 speakerphone also supports up to 85W reverse charging. Simply plug in your USB-C power adapter or display to its USB-C port, then you can easily charge your PC, with no need to worry about running out of power.

HALO 90 speakerphone supports acoustic echo cancellation, active background noise reduction and voice enhancement. Its outstanding audio quality can ensure everyone is heard during conference calls, making your meeting more efficient.

HALO 90 speakerphone features a 2W speaker, which can cover any space of a 30?O meeting room, so you won‘t miss a word. Furthermore, the AGC technology balances out voice volume in real-time to ensure no one sounds too close or too far away from it.

The full-duplex design allows conversations to flow just as they do in person. Especially in a multi-person video conference, the conversations from every side are transmitted naturally and clearly at the same time. It ensures effective communication and improves teamwork efficiency.

HALO 90 speakerphone is compatible with all leading UC platforms, like Zoom, Skype, Teams, WebEx, etc. You can easily connect with colleagues around the world for a seamless meeting experience, whatever platform you‘re using.

HALO 90 speakerphone is also compatible with various operating systems, including Mac OS, Windows 7/8/10/11, Android and iOS. Connect it to your computer via USB cable and you can make a conference call just in a few seconds.

Enable the unique presenter tracking mode on #WyreStorm HALO# software when you have an online presentation at home. Wherever you stand to present and move around, the camera lens can automatically follow you in real time and ensure your image remains in the center.

You can also enable the unique speaker tracking mode on #WyreStorm HALO# software when in your company's meeting room. The camera can automatically pick out the active speaker from your team and ensure the speaker's image remains in the center. It provides a natural flow to the conversation, allowing the far end to see the speaker and body language better.

Auto framing is designed for meeting room scenario. When someone enters or leaves the meeting room, the camera lens can automatically reframe to present an optimal view. It can ensure all attendees are clearly reflected in the image and also put in the appropriate position.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Now Zoom certified, hold a smooth and productive video conference with the HALO VX10 v2 video bar. It integrates a 4K wide-angle AI camera, dual powerful stereo speaker and a beamforming four-microphone array into one device, offering you extraordinary audio and video experience. With its outstanding functions and exquisite design, HALO VX10 v2 is ideal for small meeting room, huddle room as well as home office.
Supports Windows/MacOS App for Configuration & Control

Whether you work from home or in your company’s meeting room, HALO VX10 v2 video bar is your best choice! It is integrated with one 4K AI camera, dual powerful stereo speaker and four noise-cancelling microphones, meeting all your needs for a smooth and productive video conference.

Built with dual full-frequency stereo speakers, HALO VX10 v2 video bar can deliver loud and full human voice, so you can hear every word clearly from your far-end colleagues or business partners. In addition to business conference, you can also use it to play your favorite music, refreshing yourself in leisure time.

Enable the unique presenter tracking mode on “WyreStorm HALO” software when you have an online presentation at home. Wherever you stand to present and move around, the camera lens can automatically follow you in real time and ensure your image remains in the center.

You can also enable the unique speaker tracking mode on “WyreStorm HALO” software when in your company’s meeting room. The camera can automatically pick out the active speaker from your team and ensure the speaker’s image remains in the center. It provides a natural flow to the conversation, allowing the far end to see the speaker and body language better.

The HALO-VX10 v2 video bar is also compatible with various operating systems, including Mac OS and Windows 7/8/10/11. It is plug and play, no driver required. Connect it to your computer via USB-C cable and you can hold a video conference right away.

Auto framing is designed for meeting room scenario. When someone enters or leaves the meeting room, the camera lens can automatically reframe to present an optimal view. It can ensure all attendees are clearly reflected in the image and also put in the appropriate position.

Presenter tracking is designed for one lecturer scenario. Wherever you stand to present and move around, the camera lens can automatically follow you in real time and ensure your image remains in the center.

First of all, you need to download the “WyreStorm HALO” App and also the latest firmware file from the “Downloads” section in this page. After install the App on your computer, please run it and click the “Support” section to find “Customer Software Update”. In this option, you can upload the firmware file from your computer for upgrading.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.
Supports Wide Dynamic Range (WDR) for Clear Image in Any Light
Supports Windows/MacOS APP for Video Configuration & Color Adjustment

Designed with a premium lens and advanced CMOS sensor, the webcam can seamlessly stream up to 1080P Full HD distortion-less image to your computer. It can also record vibrant video clips that capture the smallest details.

Built with the unique ISP image algorithm, our webcam supports automatic white balance adjustment and backlight compensation. Even if you work in harsh lighting environments, you can always look bright, clear and professional in front of your clients, colleagues, and bosses.

Speakerphone supports acoustic echo cancellation, active background noise reduction and voice enhancement. Its outstanding audio quality can ensure everyone is heard during conference calls, making your meeting more efficient.

The full-duplex design allows conversations to flow just as they do in person. Especially in a multi-person video conference, the conversations from every side are transmitted naturally and clearly at the same time. It ensures effective communication and improves teamwork efficiency.

Our webcam and speakerphone is also compatible with various operating systems, including Mac OS, Windows , Android and iOS. Connect it to your computer and you can make a conference call just in a few seconds.

Our speakerphone features a slim, compact design. Whether in the office or at home, you can connect it to your laptop and hold a conference call almost anywhere. Perfect for online learning, teaching or academic speech.

The full HD webcam is equipped with a 100° wide-angle distortionless lens. It supports automatic white balance adjustment and low light compensation. It has a built-in microphone and an attached privacy cover. It is plug-n-play, and can work with Zoom, Skype, Teams, Google Meet, etc.

The webcam’s lens is fixed focus, pre-set to a specific focus range. As it is designed with 100° wide-angle lens featuring a wide depth of field (DOF), it can render everything in a scene in focus. Compared with auto-focus webcams, fixed-focus webcams allow for more precise focusing, better for macro and portrait shots, and better for low-light photography. To enrich our product line, we will release new webcams that have auto focus in the future.
4. What are the main features of speakerphone?

The USB conference speakerphone is built with four noise-cancelling mics and a premium speaker. It can pick up sounds from every angle of your meeting space and ensure everyone is heard. It boasts superior sound quality, 360° voice pickup, plug-n-play feature and portable design, ideal for both home office and meeting room of 2 to 4 people.
We offer 24/7 global service and support. Please feel free to contact us on the phone, email or live chat! We are always happy to help.
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The IDB series in-desk connectivity products are simple to use solutions for corporate or education applications. Easy to install into a desk or table, the IDB-200 offers the essential connectivity for your meeting, lecture, or classroom. The IDB-200 features a flip-top lid to protect and help blend into the desk when not in use. The IDB-200-NA includes a North American Type B mains outlet.
The compact design allows the IDB-200 to be installed into small tables or desks without being obtrusive. The flip-top cover allows the IDB-200 to be discrete when not in use.
Two region-based models. The IDB-200-NA comes with a North American mains connection and the IDB-200-MS with a multi-standard mains to support multiple European countries.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The IDB-300-BTN is a premium tabletop connectivity solution designed for modern meeting spaces, conference rooms, and hybrid work environments. Featuring dual input channels (USB-C and HDMI+USB), this compact device allows users to seamlessly switch between sources with a simple touch of a button.

With built-in Power Delivery (PD) up to 60W and Ethernet passthrough*, users can charge their devices and maintain a stable wired network connection, eliminating the need for extra adapters. The intuitive button control function provides instant source selection, while the integrated cable management system keeps the workspace neat and organized.

Designed to work with MX-0402-MST and SW-640L-TX-W, the IDB-300-BTN ensures seamless integration into BYOD/BYOM environments, making it the perfect solution for professional presentations and collaboration.

The IDB-300-BTN supports USB-C and HDMI+USB inputs, allowing users to connect two devices simultaneously. The source switching buttons ensures smooth transitions between sources without delays or manual re-plugging.
INTEGRATED CABLE MANAGEMENT FOR A CLEAN WORKSPACE

Keep meeting tables free of tangled wires with a built-in retractable cable system. The In-Desk Box neatly stores USB-C, HDMI, and USB cables under the table while allowing for a 1.2m extension, providing a clean and professional workspace

The IDB-300-BTN features two touch-sensitive buttons, allowing users to quickly select their preferred input. LED indicators provide real-time status updates, making it easy to manage device connections in the meeting room.

Designed to work with MX-0402-MST and SW-640L-TX-W, the IDB-300 integrates effortlessly into BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) and BYOM (Bring Your Own Meeting) setups, making it the ideal solution for modern conference rooms and professional collaboration spaces

The USB-C port supports up to 60W Power Delivery (PD), ensuring laptops remain charged during meetings. Additionally, Ethernet passthrough provides a stable wired network connection, reducing reliance on Wi-Fi for seamless collaboration. PD and EP availability based on connected devices.

Designed for seamless integration into meeting tables, the CableBox features an 80mm cut-out hole and supports table thicknesses from 5mm to 45mm. Its compact form factor ensures a discreet yet highly functional installation.

The built-in retractable cable system allows users to extend cables up to 1.2m above the table, providing easy access to connections while keeping cables neatly stored when not in use. This design ensures a clean, professional meeting space and extends the lifespan of the cables by preventing tangling and excessive bending.
Spring-loaded flip up design allows you to simply push on the lid to expose the ports

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The IDB series in-desk connectivity products are simple to use solutions for corporate or education applications. Easy to install into a desk or table, the IDB-400 offers a broad range of connectivity for your meeting, lecture, or classroom. The spring-loaded flip up design allows you to simply push on the lid to expose the ports. The IDB-400-MS includes a Type G mains outlet.
Equipped with 2x HDMI and a USB-C connection, the IDB-400 series has your video input options covered. It also features an RJ-45 passthrough for getting wired up to the internet.
The sleek flip up design allows you to simply press on the cover to expose the ports. Push the cover down to lock it in place for a discrete look when not in use.
Two region-based models. The IDB-400-NA comes with a North American mains connection and the IDB-400-MS with a multi-standard mains to support multiple European countries.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The IDB series in-desk connectivity products are simple to use solutions for corporate or education applications. Easy to install into a desk or table, the IDB-400 offers a broad range of connectivity for your meeting, lecture, or classroom. The spring-loaded flip up design allows you to simply push on the lid to expose the ports. The IDB-400-NA includes a North American Type B mains outlet.
Equipped with 2x HDMI and a USB-C connection, the IDB-400 series has your video input options covered. It also features an RJ-45 passthrough for getting wired up to the internet.
The sleek flip up design allows you to simply press on the cover to expose the ports. Push the cover down to lock it in place for a discrete look when not in use.
Two region-based models. The IDB-400-NA comes with a North American mains connection and the IDB-400-MS with a multi-standard mains to support multiple European countries.

maxResolutions: 4K60 multiview processor supporting up to four
evidence: The MV-0401-PRO is a powerful multiview switcher that can be used as a standalone solution or with a NetworkHD system. The switcher comes pre-loaded with six different multiview layouts offering unique viewing experiences. 4K60 HDMI 2.0 inputs allow the switcher to support all the latest 4K HDR content with zero compression. Customizable multiview layout and arbitrary scaling adjustments, with real-time layout changes and live scaling display. For LED output compatibility, it supports LED screen resolutions up to 8 million pixels, including standard 4K output as well as custom resolutions such as 8K×1K and 1K×8K for special LED display scenarios.

Each input supports the latest HDMI 2.0 content, including 4K60 4:4:4 and high dynamic range such as HDR10, HLG and Dolby Vision. A built-in HDMI downscaler will automatically adjust the resolution to match the maximum capability of the connected display.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The MV-0401-PRO is a powerful multiview switcher that can be used as a standalone solution or with a NetworkHD system. The switcher comes pre-loaded with six different multiview layouts offering unique viewing experiences. 4K60 HDMI 2.0 inputs allow the switcher to support all the latest 4K HDR content with zero compression. Customizable multiview layout and arbitrary scaling adjustments, with real-time layout changes and live scaling display. For LED output compatibility, it supports LED screen resolutions up to 8 million pixels, including standard 4K output as well as custom resolutions such as 8K×1K and 1K×8K for special LED display scenarios.

Each input supports the latest HDMI 2.0 content, including 4K60 4:4:4 and high dynamic range such as HDR10, HLG and Dolby Vision. A built-in HDMI downscaler will automatically adjust the resolution to match the maximum capability of the connected display.

The MV-0401-PRO is specifically designed to fit perfectly inside the NHD-000-RACK4, making it easy to be part of a NetworkHD system. Slot the switcher next other encoders and decoders for a tidy and convenient installation.

The MX-0402-MST Conference Presentation Switcher is the ultimate solution for modern conference rooms. Designed to simplify and enhance your presentation experience, this 4x2 switcher integrates video, audio, USB, control, and Ethernet functionalities. With dual USB-C and dual HDMI inputs, automatic switching capabilities, and advanced USB 3.2 ports, the MX-0402-MST ensures seamless connectivity and control for all your conference needs. Experience crystal-clear 4K video, high-speed data transfer, and efficient power delivery with this state-of-the-art presentation switcher.

The MX-0402-MST Conference Presentation Switcher features dual USB-C and dual HDMI inputs, allowing for versatile connectivity. Each input port supports cable lock connections, ensuring secure and stable connections for your presentation devices.

Experience the full potential of USB-C with support for 4K video, USB 3.2 data transfer, and 60W charging. The MX-0402-MST also supports dual video output via a single USB-C cable, providing exceptional flexibility for multi-screen presentations.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The MX-0403-H3-MST Conference Presentation Switcher builds on the success of the MX-0402-MST by adding an HDBaseT 3.0 output for signal extension of up to 100m. Designed to simplify and enhance your presentation experience, this 4x3 switcher integrates video, audio, USB, control, and Ethernet functionalities. With dual USB-C and dual HDMI inputs, automatic switching capabilities, and advanced USB 3.2 ports, the MX-0403-H3-MST ensures seamless connectivity and control for all your conference needs. Experience crystal-clear 4K video, high-speed data transfer, and efficient power delivery with this state-of-the-art presentation switcher.

The MX-0403-H3-MST Conference Presentation Switcher features dual USB-C and dual HDMI inputs, allowing for versatile connectivity. Each input port supports cable lock connections, ensuring secure and stable connections for your presentation devices.

Experience the full potential of USB-C with support for 4K video, USB 3.2 data transfer, and 60W charging. The MX-0403-H3-MST also supports dual video output via a single USB-C cable, providing exceptional flexibility for multi-screen presentations.

Specific to the version 3 model, the MXV 8×8 gives users many options to power displays on and off. These options include RS-232 routing to discreet zones, as well as using automatic, API and custom generated triggered CEC commands.
The Switcher also features an HDBT 3.0 output for extension to remote zones (Up to 100m), enabling IP to RS-232 command routing at the display zone for controlling displays and other devices.

In addition to the audio breakout ports, the MXV 8×8 also features four HDMI mirrored output ports which can be paired with any of WyreStorm’s HAOC hybrid optical HDMI cables for transmission up to 50m/164ft or any extender for transmission of HDBaseT or OM3 fiber.

The WyreStorm MX-0404-HDMI is a powerful plug and play matrix switcher, bundled in a small compact chassis for ease of installation. An 18Gbps matrix switcher, it allows up to four 4K sources to be independently routed to four displays. Additionally, each output has the capability to scale 4K content down to connected 1080p displays without affecting 4K sources. Audio following the output can be extracted via the digital 5.1 S/PDIF, allowing it to be sent to an external audio distribution system.
This small, yet robust 18Gbps HDMI switch comes fully equipped to fit in a standard 19” rack space, designed with professional installations in mind.

Bigger isn’t always better. The MX-0404-HDMI was designed with professional installations in mind. Because of its small chassis, the MX-0404-HDMI is a breeze to install, and with the included brackets, it can also be integrated into a standard 1U rack space making the MX-0404-HDMI a robust matrix for its size.

Sporting a pure 18Gbps HDMI backplane, supporting all UHD video signals up to and including 2160p 4:4:4/60, and high frame-rate HDR 12bit 4:2:2 up to 60Hz, along with multichannel audio up to DTS:X and Dolby Atmos.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm MX-0404-HDMI is a powerful plug and play matrix switcher, bundled in a small compact chassis for ease of installation. An 18Gbps matrix switcher, it allows up to four 4K sources to be independently routed to four displays. Additionally, each output has the capability to scale 4K content down to connected 1080p displays without affecting 4K sources. Audio following the output can be extracted via the digital 5.1 S/PDIF, allowing it to be sent to an external audio distribution system.
This small, yet robust 18Gbps HDMI switch comes fully equipped to fit in a standard 19” rack space, designed with professional installations in mind.
Each output is built with an effective 4K to 1080p downscaler, allowing a mix of 4K and 1080p screens to show at their highest potential without affecting 4K sources.

Bigger isn’t always better. The MX-0404-HDMI was designed with professional installations in mind. Because of its small chassis, the MX-0404-HDMI is a breeze to install, and with the included brackets, it can also be integrated into a standard 1U rack space making the MX-0404-HDMI a robust matrix for its size.

Sporting a pure 18Gbps HDMI backplane, supporting all UHD video signals up to and including 2160p 4:4:4/60, and high frame-rate HDR 12bit 4:2:2 up to 60Hz, along with multichannel audio up to DTS:X and Dolby Atmos.

The MX-0808-H2A-MK2 is a welcome refresh to the powerful line of H2A pure HDMI switchers. The MK2 is familiar on the surface but has a host of improvements and added features. To start, the HDMI outputs now feature 5K & 1080p downscalers promoting easier integration of mixed resolution displays into a single system. The HDMI outputs also now support Audio Return Channel from smart TVs to bring audio from apps like Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, etc.…to an external audio system. Speaking of audio, the analog audio outputs have been updated to balanced connections to ensure there is no loss in fidelity or interference.
Each of the 8 outputs on the MK2 feature down scalers, allowing support for mixed resolution distribution of HDMI content to 5K and 1080p display simultaneously.

All 8 HDMI outputs support Audio Return Channel from smart TVs apps like Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, etc.….The ARC audio can then be sent through either the digital S/PDIF or balanced analog outputs to an AVR or stereo amp.
As a standard requirement with the latest WyreStorm products, the MK2 supports the latest video formats including 5K HDR and Dolby Vision content all in uncompressed HDMI glory.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The MX-0808-H2A-MK2 is a welcome refresh to the powerful line of H2A pure HDMI switchers. The MK2 is familiar on the surface but has a host of improvements and added features. To start, the HDMI outputs now feature 5K & 1080p downscalers promoting easier integration of mixed resolution displays into a single system. The HDMI outputs also now support Audio Return Channel from smart TVs to bring audio from apps like Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, etc.…to an external audio system. Speaking of audio, the analog audio outputs have been updated to balanced connections to ensure there is no loss in fidelity or interference.
Each of the 8 outputs on the MK2 feature down scalers, allowing support for mixed resolution distribution of HDMI content to 5K and 1080p display simultaneously.

All 8 HDMI outputs support Audio Return Channel from smart TVs apps like Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, etc.….The ARC audio can then be sent through either the digital S/PDIF or balanced analog outputs to an AVR or stereo amp.
As a standard requirement with the latest WyreStorm products, the MK2 supports the latest video formats including 5K HDR and Dolby Vision content all in uncompressed HDMI glory.

The MX-0808-KIT v2 gets a make over, sharing many of the same powerful features of version 1, but with a vision of lite commercial installations in mind. Offering the same transmissions of 4K UHD up to 35m/115ft, but now up to 8 HDBaseT outputs with included receivers. Also new and fitting are 4 balanced analog audio outputs 2ch support to connect to ceiling/over-hanging speakers or to an audio amplifier. Lastly, still enjoy the same great features of version 1, including CEC triggering, A/V mute and standby mode to extend the life of the matrix during downtime.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The MX-0808-KIT v2 gets a make over, sharing many of the same powerful features of version 1, but with a vision of lite commercial installations in mind. Offering the same transmissions of 4K UHD up to 35m/115ft, but now up to 8 HDBaseT outputs with included receivers. Additionally, version 2 is equipped with 4 mirrored outputs, which can be paired with any of our HAOC hybrid optical HDMI cables to connect to 4 additional screens. Also new and fitting are 4 balanced analog audio outputs 2ch support to connect to ceiling/over-hanging speakers or to an audio amplifier. Lastly, still enjoy the same great features of version 1, including CEC triggering, A/V mute and standby mode to extend the life of the matrix during downtime.

In the modern House of Worship venues, video distribution to a few screens or large displays paired with just as powerful 2 channel audio distribution is common place. The MX-0808-KIT v2 ensures a workhorse AV matrix distribution system for up to 8 endpoints, all while keeping longevity and system health in mind with the Standby Mode, allowing for distribution to save on energy when not in use.

8 kit can handle current video content up to 4K/60 4:2:0 covering a majority of current source devices, even supporting 10-bit HDR content at up to 30Hz and multi-channel audio. Powerful HDBaseT technology sends this, IR control and PoH for the included
8 kit can send power trigger commands to all compatible connected screens or projectors meaning an integrated autonomous control solution.
SmartEDID feature also dynamically detects display/source capabilities and automatically outputs the highest possible resolution
mbedded WyreStorm WebUI enables simple source switching and installer set-up & configuration
WebUI includes full EDID management to copy EDID from connected devices
ompact 1U chassis with adjustable depth rack mounting brackets included

4K60 8x8 Seamless Scaling HDMI Matrix with USB-C Support

The MX-0808-SCL is a sophisticated HDMI matrix switcher designed for fast Seamless switching. Perfectly suited for professional environments such as corporate training rooms, hotel meeting spaces, and academic classrooms, this device boasts an integrated 4K60 scaler on each HDMI output, scaling from 480p to 2160p. Additionally, it features a comprehensive USB-C input . delivering support for 4K60 video, a 1GbE passthrough network connection, and PD3.0 USB host charging up to 60 watts, ensuring compatibility and ease of use across a variety of devices and setups.

Seamless fast switching up to 4K60 across all video inputs and outputs with less than 50ms delay. Provides a smooth, instantaneous transition between video sources without any noticeable lag or interruption. Enhancing the viewer experience in professional and entertainment settings, ensuring high-quality presentations and displays without disruptions.

Features like automatic video input and output detection, and built-in scalers on each output, enable the matrix to deliver high-quality video tailored to the resolution of each connected display, ensuring the best possible image quality across all screens.

With support for de-embedded audio from HDMI inputs to balanced output ports, this feature enables precise audio routing completely independent of video signals. This flexibility allows for the creation of customized audio experiences tailored to the unique needs of your space.

4K60 8x8 Seamless Scaling HDMI Matrix with USB-C Support

The MX-0808-SCL is a sophisticated HDMI matrix switcher designed for fast Seamless switching. Perfectly suited for professional environments such as corporate training rooms, hotel meeting spaces, and academic classrooms, this device boasts an integrated 4K60 scaler on each HDMI output, scaling from 480p to 2160p. Provides a smooth, instantaneous transition between video sources without any noticeable lag or interruption. Features like automatic video input and output detection, and built-in scalers on each output, enable the matrix to deliver high-quality video tailored to the resolution of each connected display, ensuring the best possible image quality across all screens.

With support for de-embedded audio from HDMI inputs to balanced output ports, this feature enables precise audio routing completely independent of video signals. This flexibility allows for the creation of customized audio experiences tailored to the unique needs of your space.

Perfectly suited for professional environments such as corporate training rooms, hotel meeting spaces, and academic classrooms, this device boasts an integrated 4K60 scaler on each HDMI output, scaling from 480p to 2160p. Additionally, it features a comprehensive USB-C input . delivering support for 4K60 video, a 1GbE passthrough network connection, and PD3.0 USB host charging up to 60 watts, ensuring compatibility and ease of use across a variety of devices and setups.

Seamless fast switching up to 4K60 across all video inputs and outputs with less than 50ms delay. Provides a smooth, instantaneous transition between video sources without any noticeable lag or interruption. Enhancing the viewer experience in professional and entertainment settings, ensuring high-quality presentations and displays without disruptions.

Features like automatic video input and output detection, and built-in scalers on each output, enable the matrix to deliver high-quality video tailored to the resolution of each connected display, ensuring the best possible image quality across all screens.

With support for de-embedded audio from HDMI inputs to balanced output ports, this feature enables precise audio routing completely independent of video signals. This flexibility allows for the creation of customized audio experiences tailored to the unique needs of your space.

evidence: The MX-0812-SCL is an HDMI matrix switcher featuring 8 HDMI inputs and 12 outputs, each capable of handling 4K60 video, with advanced scaling for each output. It includes video processing capabilities for video walls, such as cropping and bezel correction, as well as multiview options like Picture-in-Picture and Quad view. Designed for various applications, it offers seamless switching, video wall control, and multiview support, alongside comprehensive audio support through HDMI de-embedding, analog, and Dante audio connections.

Featuring video wall processing capabilities, including cropping, bezel correction, scaling, and the ability to rotate images by 90, 180, or 270 degrees (Outputs 9-12). Additionally, it supports grouping functions for enhanced video wall presentations. The matrix also offers sophisticated multiview capabilities, supporting the simultaneous display of up to four separate video sources on a single screen. When activated, the multiview configuration is mirrored across HDMI outputs 1 to 4, ensuring consistent visual outputs on multiple displays. It supports a variety of multiview layouts, including Picture-in-Picture (PIP), Picture-by-Picture (PBP), Split Screen, Master view, and Quad view, catering to different viewing preferences and requirements. This flexibility makes it ideal for scenarios requiring real-time monitoring of multiple video feeds, such as control rooms, live events, and professional broadcasting environments.

The Matrix provides three distinct working modes tailored for system integrator projects: seamless matrix switching, video wall controller, and multiview switcher. This versatility makes it well-suited for a variety of applications and user needs. Designed with flexibility in mind, it supports both vertical and horizontal screen orientations and offers flexible configuration to meet the diverse requirements of professional environments.

The MX-0812-SCL integrates HDMI audio de-embedding, analog audio connections, and a Dante 4x4 network for expansive audio distribution. Specifically, the Matrix supports de-embedding audio from 8 HDMI inputs and includes 4 Dante inputs for extensive networked audio integration. Additionally, it provides 4 analog audio outputs and 4 Dante audio outputs, enabling flexible audio setups. A key highlight is the capability for independent audio switching, allowing any of the 12 audio inputs to be directed to any of the 8 audio outputs, ensuring tailored audio management for diverse requirements.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.
This 10x10 custom matrix chassis is built to your custom specification from a range of TX-H2X transmission cards, allowing hundreds of variations at your disposal.

The optional TX-H2X-OM3 transmission card now allows the powerful ability to pass the full bandwidth required of HDMI 2.0 over long distances via HDBaseT TM by utilizing Variable Compression technology over Multimode Fiber.

The integrated digital audio matrix can manage up to 30 multi-channel sources, which is made up of audio from the connected HDMI or remote HDBaseT TM sources, separate audio-only devices via S/PDIF and multi-channel ARC from HDBaseT TM zones.

The optional TX-H2X-HDBT input card allows source devices to be de-centralized and sent remotely back to the head-end. A large switching eco-system can be created using WyreStorm's huge range of HDBaseT TM transmission devices.
Fiber output supporting 4K/60 4:4:4 or 12-bit HDR to 300m/984ft
10-slot 4K UHD matrix switcher featuring 10 inputs and 10 switchable zone outputs with integrated audio matrixing
18Gb/s backplane for support of HDMI2.0 video standard
Supports HDR-10 HLG and Dolby Vision TM HDR content
Integrated audio matrix supports up to 30 audio inputs: HDMI de-embed, S/PDIF in and Audio Return
Audio DSP allows adjustment of volume, EQ and delay for every audio zone
Delivers PoH to every HDBaseT zone, powering receivers
SmartEDID TM feature dynamically solves mixed resolution conflicts when combining 2K/4K screens in the same installation
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

As space between displays and the wall they’re mounted to reduces, finding a receiver to fit in this gap can be hard to find. But just because this receiver packs a punch doesn’t mean it can’t deliver the small footprint that you’ve come to expect. It also ships complete with all the accessories needed to help the integrator complete the install discreetly and efficiently.

The very core of WyreStorm transmission, we’ve embraced HDBaseT technology since 2010. We’re now taking the capabilities of HDBaseT to the next level and supporting video bandwidths in excess of 10Gbps with our lossless compression technology built in to out H2X matrix platform. The RXV-70-4K-G2 will output HDMI content at up to 2160p 4:4:4/60.
Compatible with HDR standards including HDR-10, HDR-10+, HLG and Dolby Vision™ (Dolby Vision supported up to 30Hz)

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The MXV-0808-H2A-KIT delivers the same powerful performance as the standalone MXV-0808-H2A matrix switcher, now bundled with 6 standard HDBaseT receivers and 2 scaling receivers—making it an ideal solution for installations with a mix of 4K and 1080p displays. Capable of transmitting full 18Gbps HDMI content up to 35m/115ft using WyreStorm’s advanced lossless compression (VLC), this kit maintains perfect signal integrity without compromising color fidelity—unlike other methods such as CSC that permanently discard color data. With 8 HDBaseT zone outputs and 4 mirrored HDMI outputs, plus CEC triggering across all 12 display connections, the MXV-0808-H2A-KIT ensures seamless video distribution in residential or commercial environments where display compatibility and reliability are key.

Specific to the version 3 model, the MXV 8×8 gives users many options to power displays on and off. These options include RS-232 routing to discreet zones, as well as using automatic, API and custom generated triggered CEC commands.

In addition to the audio breakout ports, the MXV 8×8 also features four HDMI mirrored output ports which can be paired with any of WyreStorm’s HAOC hybrid optical HDMI cables for transmission up to 50m/164ft or any extender for transmission of HDBaseT or OM3 fiber.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Working automatically on signal presence or triggered via the API, the MXV 8x8 can send power trigger commands to all compatible connected screens or projectors meaning an integrated autonomous control solution

In addition to the audio breakout ports, the MXV 8x8 also features four HDMI mirrored output ports which can be paired with any of WyreStorm's HAOC hybrid optical HDMI cables for transmission up to 50m/164ft or any extender for transmission of HDBaseT or OM3 fiber.
4K HDR HDBaseT 8x8 Matrix Switch, supporting:
Proprietary compression algorithm enables 60Hz 4K UHD content (4:4:4 or HDR) to be sent over HDBaseT to 35m/115ft
Compatible with DVI-I and DP++ v1.3 signals from compatible devices
8 Assignable audio outputs allow audio to be independently de-embedded from sources or outputs via Toslink optical
A/V Mute mode allows the routing of a signal to an output to be deactivated
API controlled standby mode allows the matrix to enter a low power state when not in use, cutting power consumption by up to 34%
SmartEDID TM feature also dynamically detects display/source capabilities and automatically outputs the highest possible resolution
Embedded WyreStorm WebUI enables simple source switching and installer set-up & configuration
WebUI includes full EDID management to read, copy, store or import EDID from connected devices
IR learning function allows source switching in a zone to be triggered by an IR command other than the default
Simple switching matrix remote control included, which can be learned into a universal remote handset to allow the control of multiple devices from one handset
Compact 1U chassis with adjustable depth rack mounting brackets included
Input supports DVI/D and DisplayPort Dual-Mode (DP++) v1.3 with adapter (not included)
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The latest in market leading matrix solutions, WyreStorm's H2L brings the familiar power of the MXV platform, offering transmission of HDMI content up to 4K/60 4:4:4 & HDR to 35m/115ft, pairing powerful HDBaseT & WyreStorm's variable lite compression technologies. The MXV-0808-H2L has 8 Class B HDBaseT zone outputs with PoH and 2 mirrored HDMI outputs; additionally, the MXV-0808-H2L also supports custom CEC triggering for all connected screens, RS232 routing and A/V mute function enhances the offering for the modern home or commercial installation.

Aimed at lighter footprint installations, the MXV-0808-H2L ticks all the boxes while keeping only the necessary features needed for the install. Geared towards high bandwidth video distribution, you'll get all the highlights and features from the MXV platform without the added cost of audio distribution.

Features only known to version 3 MXV, our 8x8 H2L also gives users many options to power displays on and off. You'll also find RS-232 routing to discreet zones, as well as using automatic, API and custom generated triggered CEC commands standard with our light version MXV.

In addition to the audio breakout ports, the 8x8 H2L also features two HDMI mirrored output ports which can be paired with any of WyreStorm's HAOC hybrid optical HDMI cables for transmission up to 50m/164ft or any extender for transmission of HDBaseT or OM3 fiber.
The AV Mute functionality gives complete distribution control to a user allowing the signal to any zone to be independently switched off without losing signal with the source.
An intuitive WebUI includes full EDID management to read, copy, store or import EDID from connected devices and much more.
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

The RXV-70-G2-SCL features a powerful scaler that can convert 4K UHD and HDR content to a 1080p non-HDR display to maximize compatibility. The receiver also features stereo and digital S/PDIF audio breakout for easy external audio distribution.

The RXV-70-G2-SCL allows video output to be scaled to match the capabliity of the connected display. Transmit a 4K HDR source to a 4K HDR display and at the same time scale another zone to 1080p without effecting the quality of the source.

The very core of WyreStorm transmission, we’ve embraced HDBaseT technology since 2010. We’re now taking the capabilities of HDBaseT to the next level and supporting video bandwidths in excess of 10Gbps with our lossless compression technology built in to out H2X matrix platform. The RXV-70-G2-SCL will output HDMI content at up to 2160p 4:4:4/60.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-000-CTL IP controller is designed to be used with NetworkHD 100, 200, 400 & 600 Series systems to bridge the various encoders and decoders to a single, API-based connection point for use by a control processor or the NetworkHD Touch TM App. The NHD-000-CTL also provides monitoring and remote access for Integrators via its on-board Web UI.
Two isolated NICs provide the option to interface with two separate Networks or VLANs offering a secure and hassle-free option for simple switch setups.

Dual Ethernet ports for complete isolation of control and AV network traffic, enables the use of multiple LANs, VLANs or unified network topologies depending on the requirements of the project. The NHD-000-CTL supports PoE, simplifying cabling and equipment considerations.

Removing the complexity of requiring a control system to talk to every NetworkHD component, the NHD-000-CTL provides a unified control and monitoring interface point. Multiple NHD-000-CTLs can co-exist on a network, offering Hot or Cold backup options for mission critical deployments.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-0401-MV is a powerful multiview switcher that can be used as a standalone solution or with a NetworkHD 400 or 500 series system. The switcher comes pre-loaded with six different multiview layouts offering unique viewing experiences. 4K60 HDMI 2.0 inputs allow the switcher to support all the latest 4K HDR content with zero compression. Direct integration with the NHD-CTL-PRO provides a seamless solution for pairing this switcher with NetworkHD encoders & decoders to add multiview capability to an AV over IP project.

Each input supports the latest HDMI 2.0 content, including 4K60 4:4:4 and high dynamic range such as HDR10, HLG and Dolby Vision. A built-in HDMI downscaler will automatically adjust the resolution to match the maximum capability of the connected display.

The NHD-0401-MV is specifically designed to fit perfectly inside the NHD-000-RACK4, making it easy to be part of a NetworkHD system. Slot the switcher next other encoders and decoders for a tidy and convenient installation.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-110-RX-S is an AV decoder to the powerful 110 series of NetworkHD components. This “S” model has been treated with Sealoc’s Weatherloc technology to resist the elements such as water, moisture, humidity, dust, salt-fog, salt-air, acidic products and more. The 110 series components supports video encoding/decoding of up to 1080p60Hz content. The NHD-110-RX can natively process up to a 16x16 video wall to create captivating digital landscapes. The 110 series components are also compatible with the NHD-150-RX multiview receiver allowing up to 9 unique streams to be sent to a single display.

A pioneering collaboration with Sealoc and their proprietary Weatherloc technology, WyreStorm weatherproofed AV over IP receivers protect the endpoints of your AV solutions from the demanding outdoor environments. From coastal climates to dust particles and everything in between, the NetworkHD Sealoc receiver provides the perfect AV solution for customer engaging patio displays, video walls for live events, or even outdoor digital signage without any need for bulky weather proof boxes that prevent ventilation.

Each NHD-110-RX-S features a powerful video scaler. These scalers can operate automatically or be forced to transmit a specific video timing and format. Having scalers ensure you will always have a video signal no matter the display you connect to. Not to mention, the amazing seamless video switching capability.

The NHD-110-TX provides a low bandwidth yet incredibly high quality video stream allowing you to easily accomplish large scale AV deployments. The 110 series components are also compatible with the NHD-150-RX multiview receiver allowing up to 9 unique streams to be sent to a single display.

The NetworkHD TM 100 Series utilizes low bandwidth, infinitely scalable technology with the addition of powerful video wall support up to 16×16 for the best all-round solution for commercial AV installations. A 100 Series encoder can either be paired with a 100 Series decoder for matrix switching to individual screens or for video wall decoding, with both decoders including HDMI and analog audio breakout outputs, or an NHD-150-RX decoder for multiview monitoring.
The NHD-110-TX can encode AV signal using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.

The NHD-110-TX is the AV encoder to the powerful 110 series of NetworkHD AV over IP components. The 110 series components provides video encoding/decoding of up to 1080p 60Hz content over a network. The NHD-110-TX provides a low bandwidth yet incredibly high quality video stream allowing you to easily accomplish large scale AV deployments. The 110 series components are also compatible with the NHD-150-RX multiview receiver allowing up to 9 unique streams to be sent to a single display.

The NetworkHD TM 100 Series utilizes low bandwidth, infinitely scalable technology with the addition of powerful video wall support up to 16×16 for the best all-round solution for commercial AV installations. A 100 Series encoder can either be paired with a 100 Series decoder for matrix switching to individual screens or for video wall decoding, with both decoders including HDMI and analog audio breakout outputs, or an NHD-150-RX decoder for multiview monitoring.
The NHD-110-TX can encode AV signal using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.

The 110 Series can operate in either a Unicast or Multicast mode. Multicast mode is the traditional method and is suggested for larger deployments of 80+ devices. Unicast mode however is great for small system and does not require a Layer 2 switch or support for IGMP Snooping, meaning you can practically use any switch you want.

Security is key in today’s world. The NetworkHD 110 series support AES 128-bit AV encryption over the network. Data sent from an NHD-110-TX is encapsulated using advanced methods to ensure that sensitive or private data cannot be accessed by 3rd-parties.

The NetworkHD 120 series takes the award-winning 100 series and elevates to a new level. The 120 series components support both video encoding/decoding. With 4K resolution, video transmissions look better than ever and use up to 6x less bandwidth. AV stream are fully secure over the network using AES 128-bit encryption methods, ensuring any sensitive data cannot be maliciously accessed. Of course, the series would not be complete without retaining the powerful video wall and Multiview processing. The 120 series does one better by adding screen rotation and mosaic video wall ability.

The NetworkHD TM 100 Series utilizes low bandwidth, infinitely scalable technology with the addition of powerful video wall support up to 16×16 for the best all-round solution for commercial AV installations. A 100 Series encoder can either be paired with a 100 Series decoder for matrix switching to individual screens or for video wall decoding, with both decoders including HDMI and analog audio breakout outputs, or an NHD-150-RX decoder for multiview monitoring.
The NHD-120-RX can decode AV signals from the transmitter using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.

The NHD-120-RX is now supporting 4K content that ensures compatibility with the HDMI v1.4 HDCP 2.2 video source, while a built-in scaler ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.

The NHD-120-TX is now supporting 4K content that ensures compatibility with the HDMI v1.4 HDCP 2.2 video source, while a built-in scaler ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.
The NHD-120-RX also allows you to create mosaic video walls with image rotation.

Boasting the ultimate in signal flexibility, the 120 Series can discretely deliver audio, infrared, and RS-232 streams separate to the video via a modular IP network. True signal breakaway can create custom assignments.
Compatible with the NetworkHD Touch and Companion Control apps. Control source, matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

The NHD-124-TX is a 4 input to 4 network stream device encoder compatible with the NetworkHD 100 an ultra low bandwidth AV over IP solution for distribution of point-to-point, one-to-many and many-to-many over a managed network. With its standards-based approach to video encoding, fast and simple system configuration and robust feature set, it provides the best value in networked video distribution.

The NHD-124-TX encoder is intended for use with 120 series decoders (sold separately) to provide a complete end-to-end video distribution system. When used in conjunction with the NHD-CTL-PRO system controller complete control integration is simple.

The NetworkHD TM 100 Series utilizes low bandwidth, infinitely scalable technology with the addition of powerful video wall support up to 16×16 for the best all-round solution for commercial AV installations. A 100 Series encoder can either be paired with a 100 Series decoder for matrix switching to individual screens or for video wall decoding, with both decoders including HDMI and analog audio breakout outputs, or an NHD-150-RX decoder for multiview monitoring.
The NHD-124-TX can encode AV signal using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.
The NHD-124-TX is now supporting 4K content that ensures compatibility with the HDMI v1.4 HDCP 2.2 video source.
Compatible with the NetworkHD Touch Control app. Control source, matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each Encoder.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-124-TX is a 4 input to 4 network stream device encoder compatible with the NetworkHD 100 an ultra low bandwidth AV over IP solution for distribution of point-to-point, one-to-many and many-to-many over a managed network. With its standards-based approach to video encoding, fast and simple system configuration and robust feature set, it provides the best value in networked video distribution.

The NHD-124-TX encoder is intended for use with 120 series decoders (sold separately) to provide a complete end-to-end video distribution system. When used in conjunction with the NHD-CTL-PRO system controller complete control integration is simple.

The NetworkHD TM 100 Series utilizes low bandwidth, infinitely scalable technology with the addition of powerful video wall support up to 16×16 for the best all-round solution for commercial AV installations. A 100 Series encoder can either be paired with a 100 Series decoder for matrix switching to individual screens or for video wall decoding, with both decoders including HDMI and analog audio breakout outputs, or an NHD-150-RX decoder for multiview monitoring.
The NHD-124-TX can encode AV signal using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.

Space is always a factor when building an AV over IP system, and lack of it can cause headaches for any installer. Our NHD-124-TX solves this by combining four transmitters into one solution, allowing you to have the same functionality on a 1U footprint.
The NHD-124-TX is now supporting 4K content that ensures compatibility with the HDMI v1.4 HDCP 2.2 video source.

Security is key in today’s world. The NHD-124-TX support AES 128-bit AV encryption over the network. Data sent from an NHD-124-TX is encapsulated using advanced methods to ensure that sensitive or private data cannot be accessed by 3rd-parties.

Security is key in today’s world. The NetworkHD 150 decoder supports AES 128-bit AV encryption over the network. Data sent to an NHD-150-RX is encapsulated using advanced methods to ensure that sensitive or private data cannot be accessed by 3rd-parties.
Compatible with the NetworkHD Touch Control app. Control source, matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each Encoder.

The NHD-400-DNT-TX encoder offers stunning 4K HDR video, multichannel audio support and video resolution scaling to seamlessly handle mixed resolution HDMI sources for matrix and video wall functionality. Equipped with a Dante audio encoder the 400 Series embraces the flexibility of standardized audio distribution. Featuring incredible low latency the 400 Series is the ideal AV over IP solution for systems where high quality and low delay are key requirements, making it perfect for demanding commercial applications.

The NHD-400-DNT-TX JPEG 2000 encoder is intended for use with any 400 Series JPEG 2000 decoder (sold separately) to provide a complete end-to-end video distribution system. When used in conjunction with Dante compatible audio equipment the 400 Series can distribute source HDMI or analog audio throughout an installation.

Delivering visually lossless 4K UHD content with HDR and HDCP 2.2 support the 400 Series ensures compatibility with the latest UHD video sources, while a built-in scaler at the decoder ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.

Empowered with a Dante audio encoder, Dante networks can benefit from the streaming of source audio from an encoder HDMI or analog port direct to Dante compatible audio amplifiers, DSPs or mixing consoles.

Supporting traditional video walls, as well as customizable mosaic styles, perfect for building captivating & creative digital signage. JPEG2000 encoding ensuring distribution integrity and video latency of less than a single frame makes the 400 Series ideal for live environments.

The NetworkHD 500s series is an HDMI 2.0 AV over IP solution. Capable of encoding up to 4K60 including Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG content. The 500 series comes loaded with a number of advanced features such as the flexibility of Ethernet or Fiber as a transport method. Ultra-low latency encoding and incredibly fast matrix switching speeds enhance the experience. A powerful routing engine allows audio, video, USB and control signals to be discretely sent to any endpoint. Create captivating video walls up to 16x16 in size and control them with the tap of a button in the amazing NetworkHD Touch control app.
Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network.

Audio Return Channel (ARC) via HDMI allows audio from a display to transmit over the network to a 500 series encoder for connection to a compatible AVR. ARC supports up to Dolby Digital Plus and DTS 5.1 formats. Have an older display? Take advantage of the Toslink passthrough to transmit audio in the same way.

Create captivating large format video walls with the ability to process up to 256 screens (16x16). Easily adjust for screen bezels to ensure the video is picture-perfect. The 500 series also allow you to create mosaic style walls with rotated screens!
The 500s are fully compatible with the NetworkHD Touch control app. Effortlessly control matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

JPEG 2000 compression delivers visually lossless video transmissions
Intuitive management and configuration via the NHD-CTL-PRO

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Mix and match all 500 series components to better tailor to your system requirements. The 500-E’s are compatible with the NHD-500-TX and RX, NHD-500-IW-TX and NHD-500-DNT-TX. Choose which encoder and decoder makes the most sense for what you need to accomplish.

Capable of encoding & decoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz. All over a 1GbE network with ultra-low latency.

Create captivating large format video walls with the ability to process up to 256 screens (16×16). Easily adjust for screen bezels to ensure the video is pixel perfect. The 500 series also allow you to create mosaic style walls with rotated screens!
The 500s are fully compatible with the NetworkHD Touch control app. Effortlessly control matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

empowers users to effortlessly monitor their devices from anywhere in the world. With a comprehensive suite of features, it enables seamless device control, firmware updates, and access to online support, all in one centralized location.

The TAA compliant NetworkHD 500s series is an HDMI 2.0 AV over IP solution. Capable of encoding up to 4K60 including Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG content. The 500 series comes loaded with a number of advanced features such as the flexibility of Ethernet or Fiber as a transport method. Ultra-low latency encoding and incredibly fast matrix switching speeds enhance the experience. A powerful routing engine allows audio, video, USB and control signals to be discretely sent to any endpoint. Create captivating video walls up to 16x16 in size and control them with the tap of a button in the amazing NetworkHD Touch control app.
Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network.

Audio Return Channel (ARC) via HDMI allows audio from a display to transmit over the network to a 500 series encoder for connection to a compatible AVR. ARC supports up to Dolby Digital Plus and DTS 5.1 formats. Have an older display? Take advantage of the Toslink passthrough to transmit audio in the same way.

Create captivating large format video walls with the ability to process up to 256 screens (16x16). Easily adjust for screen bezels to ensure the video is picture-perfect. The 500 series also allow you to create mosaic style walls with rotated screens!
The 500s are fully compatible with the NetworkHD Touch control app. Effortlessly control matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

Create captivating large format video walls with the ability to process up to 256 screens (16x16). Easily adjust for screen bezels to ensure the video is picture-perfect. The 500 series also allow you to create mosaic style walls with rotated screens!
Less than a single frame a latency (16ms) when in passthrough mode allows content to be distributed without any perceivable delay.

The NetworkHD 500s series is an HDMI 2.0 AV over IP solution. Capable of encoding up to 4K60 including Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG content. The 500 series comes loaded with a number of advanced features such as the flexibility of Ethernet or Fiber as a transport method. Ultra-low latency encoding and incredibly fast matrix switching speeds enhance the experience. A powerful routing engine allows audio, video, USB and control signals to be discretely sent to any endpoint. Create captivating video walls up to 16x16 in size and control them with the tap of a button in the amazing NetworkHD Touch control app.

Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network. NHD-500-TX v2 comes with HDMI loop out for local monitor.
Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network.

Audio Return Channel (ARC) via HDMI allows audio from a display to transmit over the network to a 500 series encoder for connection to a compatible AVR. ARC supports up to Dolby Digital Plus and DTS 5.1 formats. Have an older display? Take advantage of the Toslink passthrough to transmit audio in the same way.

Create captivating large format video walls with the ability to process up to 256 screens (16x16). Easily adjust for screen bezels to ensure the video is picture-perfect. The 500 series also allow you to create mosaic style walls with rotated screens!
The 500s are fully compatible with the NetworkHD Touch control app. Effortlessly control matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

The 500 series comes loaded with a number of advanced features such as the flexibility of Ethernet or Fiber as a transport method. Ultra-low latency encoding and incredibly fast matrix switching speeds enhance the experience. A powerful routing engine allows audio, video, USB and control signals to be discretely sent to any endpoint. Create captivating video walls up to 16x16 in size and control them with the tap of a button in the amazing NetworkHD Touch control app.

Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network. NHD-500-TX v2 comes with HDMI loop out for local monitor.
Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz over a 1GbE network.

Equipped with both Ethernet and Fiber outputs, the 500 series offers flexibility for any installation. Ethernet can support transmissions up to 100m (328ft) and fiber is capable of a stunning 550m (1800ft) using OM3 MMF.

Audio Return Channel (ARC) via HDMI allows audio from a display to transmit over the network to a 500 series encoder for connection to a compatible AVR. ARC supports up to Dolby Digital Plus and DTS 5.1 formats. Have an older display? Take advantage of the Toslink passthrough to transmit audio in the same way.

Create captivating large format video walls with the ability to process up to 256 screens (16x16). Easily adjust for screen bezels to ensure the video is picture-perfect. The 500 series also allow you to create mosaic style walls with rotated screens!
4ms when in passthrough mode allows content to be distributed without any perceivable delay.
The 500s are fully compatible with the NetworkHD Touch control app. Effortlessly control matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

empowers users to effortlessly monitor their devices from anywhere in the world. With a comprehensive suite of features, it enables seamless device control, firmware updates, and access to online support, all in one centralized location.

The NHD-600-E encoder and decoder delivers cost-optimized, high-performance SDVoE AV over IP transmission and reception. The “E” variations remove some of the I/O found on the standard encoder and decoder and retain only the core functionalities that suite most applications. Engineered for installations requiring pixel-perfect 4K60 4:4:4 video with zero-frame latency, this series supports robust 10GbE network operation with PoE+ power and a flexible AV control suite.

Deliver pixel-perfect, lossless video with support for up to 4K60 4:4:4 over HDMI 2.0, including HDR formats such as HDR10, HLG, and Dolby Vision (low latency). The SDVoE architecture ensures uncompromised image quality and zero-frame latency, while analog audio support enables flexible audio routing or de-embedding alongside HDMI audio.

Designed for streamlined installation, the NHD-600-E supports PoE+ (802.3at) power to reduce cabling complexity. HDMI 2.0 connectivity is provided on both encoder and decoder models, alongside analog audio connections and bidirectional IR and RS-232 passthrough for seamless integration with external devices.

Built on a 10GbE SDVoE network backbone, the 600-E enables reliable AV distribution across point-to-point and matrix-based systems. Integrated support for network-based control allows IR and RS-232 signals to be transmitted alongside video and audio, ensuring compatibility with third-party control platforms and automation systems.

Powered by SDVoE technology, the NHD-600-E delivers true zero-frame latency for real-time video transmission. This ensures perfectly synchronized audio and video, making it ideal for live presentation environments, control rooms, and interactive AV systems where timing accuracy is critical.

The NHD-600-E encoder and decoder delivers cost-optimized, high-performance SDVoE AV over IP transmission and reception. The “E” variations remove some of the I/O found on the standard encoder and decoder and retain only the core functionalities that suite most applications. Engineered for installations requiring pixel-perfect 4K60 4:4:4 video with zero-frame latency, this series supports robust 10GbE network operation with PoE+ power and a flexible AV control suite.

Deliver pixel-perfect, lossless video with support for up to 4K60 4:4:4 over HDMI 2.0, including HDR formats such as HDR10, HLG, and Dolby Vision (low latency). The SDVoE architecture ensures uncompromised image quality and zero-frame latency, while analog audio support enables flexible audio routing or de-embedding alongside HDMI audio.

Designed for streamlined installation, the NHD-600-E supports PoE+ (802.3at) power to reduce cabling complexity. HDMI 2.0 connectivity is provided on both encoder and decoder models, alongside analog audio connections and bidirectional IR and RS-232 passthrough for seamless integration with external devices.

Built on a 10GbE SDVoE network backbone, the 600-E enables reliable AV distribution across point-to-point and matrix-based systems. Integrated support for network-based control allows IR and RS-232 signals to be transmitted alongside video and audio, ensuring compatibility with third-party control platforms and automation systems.

Powered by SDVoE technology, the NHD-600-E delivers true zero-frame latency for real-time video transmission. This ensures perfectly synchronized audio and video, making it ideal for live presentation environments, control rooms, and interactive AV systems where timing accuracy is critical.
