featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-600-TRX is a transceiver capable of lossless latency-free 4K60 over a 10GbE network. The TRX allows you to transmit and receive A/V simultaneous through a single device or be programmed to act as a dedicated TX or RX. 3x USB HID ports allow extension for keyboard and mouse applications such as a corporate meeting room or an operating center. A cutting-edge architecture provides an efficient, small footprint and support for PoE+.

With all the bells & whistles of a flagship AV over IP solution, the NetworkHD 600 Series provides clarity and performance for those environments requiring detail and responsiveness. Whether monitoring mission critical AV feeds from a control room, immersed in the competitive E-Sports environment, or requiring crystal clear visuals in the medical field, this AV over IP distribution solution exceeds with no limitations.

Our award-winning NetworkHD line keeps on winning! Our NHD-600-TRX manages to scoop up Best in Market at Integrated Systems Europe 2022. Brought to the market by six leading brands within the industry, the award celebrates outstanding products and solutions within the AV landscape.

Unlike similar products in the market, the NetworkHD 600 Transceiver gives you the option to be a transmitter or receiver, without locking it into being one or the other. This means you can have remote sources connected to a "receiver" and loop it back into the system, allowing it to be viewed anywhere in a building.

All 600 series components support encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG. Most HDMI content is transmitted completely uncompressed and delivered over the network latency free using genlock synchronization.

The NHD-600-TRX integrates powerful video wall and multiview processing via one device. Create captivating videos up to 8×8 in size with the ability to adjust for bezels. Or create compelling picture in picture layouts that support up to 16 windows with full control over window placement and size.

empowers users to effortlessly monitor their devices from anywhere in the world. With a comprehensive suite of features, it enables seamless device control, firmware updates, and access to online support, all in one centralized location.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-600-TRXF is a SDVoE fiber transceiver capable of lossless, latency-free 4K60 over a 10Gb network. The TRXF allows you to transmit and receive A/V simultaneous through a single device or be programmed to act as a dedicated TX or RX. The SFP+ connector supports up to 10km using SMF, 10Gbps transmission distance for extremely long reach commercial applications. 3x High-Speed USB 2.0 ports allow extension for keyboard mouse applications and even compatibility with webcams, touchscreens, and media storage.

With all the bells & whistles of a flagship AV over IP solution, the NetworkHD 600 Series provides clarity and performance for those environments requiring detail and responsiveness. Whether monitoring mission critical AV feeds from a control room, immersed in the competitive E-Sports environment, or requiring crystal clear visuals in the medical field, this AV over IP distribution solution exceeds with no limitations.

One model to rule them all! As a transceiver the TRXF can transmit and receive up to 4K60 video simultaneously. You can even pick and choose how the device works by allowing it to be a native transceiver, or fixed as a dedicated encoder or decoder.

The TRXF features both a USB host and 3x devices ports. The highspeed chipset allows full USB 2.0 480Mbps data rates ensuring compatibility with practically any peripheral you plug in. Genlock mode allows for a latency-free experience, ideal for interactive USB devices such as a keyboard/mouse, touchscreen or webcams

The TRXF integrates powerful video wall and multiview processing via one device. Create captivating videos up to 8×8 in size with the ability to adjust for bezels. Or create compelling picture in picture layouts that support up to 16 windows with full control over window placement and size.

empowers users to effortlessly monitor their devices from anywhere in the world. With a comprehensive suite of features, it enables seamless device control, firmware updates, and access to online support, all in one centralized location.

The NetworkHD 610 TX and RX expand the functionality of the powerful SDVoE 600 series product line. The 610s retain many of the capabilities found on the other models, such as full HDMI 2.0 encoding, zero latency transmissions, video wall and multiview processing. However, the 610s pack an extra punch by incorporating a Dante/AES67 output on the NHD-610-TX, allowing audio from the HDMI or analog audio input to transmit to Dante/AES67 enabled amplifiers, DSP or mixers. Both the TX and RX are also equipped with a full speed USB 2.0 chipset maximizing compatibility with thousands of USB peripherals for extension over the network, such as a keyboard/mouse, webcams, touchscreens, or just simple data transfers.

The NHD-610-TX is equipped with a 2CH Dante audio transmitter. Audio from either the HDMI or analog audio input can be sent over the network using Dante protocols for a latency free and lossless delivery to compatible audio equipment. We’ve also made sure AES67 is supported to expand compatibility with even more audio receivers.

All 600 series components support encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG. Most HDMI content is transmitted completely uncompressed and delivered over the network latency free using genlock synchronization.

The NHD-610-RX integrates powerful video wall and multiview processing via one device. Create captivating videos up to 8x8 in size with the ability to adjust for bezels. Or create compelling picture in picture layouts that support up to 16 windows with full control over window placement and size.

However, the 610s pack an extra punch by incorporating a Dante/AES67 output on the NHD-610-TX, allowing audio from the HDMI or analog audio input to transmit to Dante/AES67 enabled amplifiers, DSP or mixers. Both the TX and RX are also equipped with a full speed USB 2.0 chipset maximizing compatibility with thousands of USB peripherals for extension over the network, such as a keyboard/mouse, webcams, touchscreens, or just simple data transfers.

With all the bells & whistles of a flagship AV over IP solution, the NetworkHD 610 Series provides clarity and performance for those environments requiring detail and responsiveness. Whether monitoring mission critical AV feeds from a control room, immersed in the competitive E-Sports environment, or requiring crystal clear visuals in the medical field, this AV over IP distribution solution exceeds with no limitations.

The NHD-610-TX is equipped with a 2CH Dante audio transmitter. Audio from either the HDMI or analog audio input can be sent over the network using Dante protocols for a latency free and lossless delivery to compatible audio equipment. We’ve also made sure AES67 is supported to expand compatibility with even more audio receivers.

Both the TX and RX are equipped with USB host and devices ports. The highspeed chipset allows full USB 2.0 480Mbps data rates ensuring compatibility with practically any peripheral you plug in. The USB data flow can be customized allowing either the 610-TX or RX to act as a USB host depending on application requirements.

All 600 series components support encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG. Most HDMI content is transmitted completely uncompressed and delivered over the network latency free using genlock synchronization.

The NHD-610-RX integrates powerful video wall and multiview processing via one device. Create captivating videos up to 8x8 in size with the ability to adjust for bezels. Or create compelling picture in picture layouts that support up to 16 windows with full control over window placement and size.
Compatible with the 802.3at PoE+ protocol, the 610s can power from a compatible network switch removing the need to use cumbersome DC power supplies.
An auxiliary 1GbE LAN port provides a bridged connection to the main 10G port for connecting peripherals. It can also be setup to isolate Dante audio to a separate network.
Supports seamless AV source switching via Fast Switch mode
Powerful matrix functionality includes routing control of all audio, video, RS-232 and IR signals
Compatible with NHD-000-RACK4 for easy rack mounting
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

The NetworkHD 610-TX expand the functionality of the powerful SDVoE 600 series product line. The 610-TX retain many of the capabilities found on the other models, such as full HDMI 2.0 encoding, zero latency transmissions, video wall and multiview processing. However, the 610 packs an extra punch by incorporating a Dante/AES67 output, allowing audio from the HDMI or analog audio input to transmit to Dante/AES67 enabled amplifiers, DSP or mixers. The TX is also equipped with a full speed USB 1.1 HID chipset, maximizing compatibility with thousands of USB peripherals for extension over the network, such as a keyboard/mouse & touchscreens, or just simple data transfers.

The NHD-610-TX is equipped with a 2CH Dante audio transmitter. Audio from either the HDMI or analog audio input can be sent over the network using Dante protocols for a latency free and lossless delivery to compatible audio equipment. We’ve also made sure AES67 is supported to expand compatibility with even more audio receivers.

All 600 series components support encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG. Most HDMI content is transmitted completely uncompressed and delivered over the network latency free using genlock synchronization.

interfaces: The NHD-RACK-1U is a compact 1U rack mount unit specifically engineered to deliver a sleek, organized installation solution for up to 2 NetworkHD 100/500/600 Series and NHD-CTL-PRO v2 devices. Designed with precision, this rack mount ensures that your NetworkHD components are securely housed while maintaining optimal airflow and accessibility for maintenance. The 1U 2 Slot Rack offers exceptional flexibility, allowing scaling setup by selecting the exact number of racks needed based on the quantity of devices in the NetworkHD system—whether deploying a small-scale configuration or expanding to support a larger network infrastructure.

evidence: Specifically designed to mount one or two NetworkHD 100/500/600 Series products side-by-side
1U height and shallow depth allows for high encoder density in an AV or IT equipment rack
Provides optimal thermal dissipation in a passively or actively cooled rack design to maintain premium device performance and MTBF
Enables systems to be pre-built into the rack kit prior to arriving on site to improve speed and efficiency of installation

The NHD-RACK-1U is a compact 1U rack mount unit specifically engineered to deliver a sleek, organized installation solution for up to 2 NetworkHD 100/500/600 Series and NHD-CTL-PRO v2 devices. Designed with precision, this rack mount ensures that your NetworkHD components are securely housed while maintaining optimal airflow and accessibility for maintenance. The 1U 2 Slot Rack offers exceptional flexibility, allowing scaling setup by selecting the exact number of racks needed based on the quantity of devices in the NetworkHD system—whether deploying a small-scale configuration or expanding to support a larger network infrastructure.
All mounting hardware provided: rack, brackets, blanking plates, rails, lacing bar, handles and screws.
Specifically designed for organizing NetworkHD components within the main rack location, the NHD-RACK-1U de-clutters the rack, improving cable management, port identification and unit access.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-RACK-1U is a compact 1U rack mount unit specifically engineered to deliver a sleek, organized installation solution for up to 2 NetworkHD 100/500/600 Series and NHD-CTL-PRO v2 devices. Designed with precision, this rack mount ensures that your NetworkHD components are securely housed while maintaining optimal airflow and accessibility for maintenance. The 1U 2 Slot Rack offers exceptional flexibility, allowing scaling setup by selecting the exact number of racks needed based on the quantity of devices in the NetworkHD system—whether deploying a small-scale configuration or expanding to support a larger network infrastructure.

Horizontal slot installation supports combination of 2 NetworkHD Series 100/500/600 components or NHD-CTL-PRO v2 providing ideal component heat dissipation and airflow – a key factor in increasing reliability and product lifespan.
All mounting hardware provided: rack, brackets, blanking plates, rails, lacing bar, handles and screws.
Specifically designed for organizing NetworkHD components within the main rack location, the NHD-RACK-1U de-clutters the rack, improving cable management, port identification and unit access.

The NHD-USB-TRX is a powerful and flexible USB 2.0 over IP transceiver designed to work natively with the WyreStorm NetworkHD 500 series or in combination with other NetworkHD series. It allows the extension of USB devices like keyboards, mice, cameras, and other peripherals over an IP network, making it ideal for point-to-point or one-to-many applications. Equipped with PoE and SFP fiber connectivity, it provides installation flexibility and reliable performance even in large-scale deployments. The built-in two-level USB hub enables seamless integration of multiple USB devices, ensuring easy management across distances.

Seamlessly extend USB 2.0 devices over an IP network with support for point-to-point or one-to-many setups. Perfect for connecting USB peripherals like cameras, keyboards, and storage devices across multiple rooms or locations.

Supports both direct point-to-point connections and one-to-many configurations via a network switch, providing up to 21 endpoints for large-scale or complex installations. This allows for efficient USB routing between multiple devices and locations.

Security is key in today’s world. The NetworkHD 110 series support AES 128-bit AV encryption over the network. Data sent from an NHD-110-TX is encapsulated using advanced methods to ensure that sensitive or private data cannot be accessed by 3rd-parties.

Boasting the ultimate in signal flexibility, the 120 Series can discretely deliver audio, infrared, and RS-232 streams separate to the video via a modular IP network. True signal breakaway can create custom assignments.

The NHD-120-TX can encode AV signal using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.
Supports up to 7 USB devices and 21 endpoints, providing local and remote USB integration for flexible device management.

Supports both direct point-to-point connections and one-to-many configurations via a network switch, providing up to 21 endpoints for large-scale or complex installations. This allows for efficient USB routing between multiple devices and locations.

Security is key in today’s world. The NetworkHD 110 series support AES 128-bit AV encryption over the network. Data sent from an NHD-110-TX is encapsulated using advanced methods to ensure that sensitive or private data cannot be accessed by 3rd-parties.

Easily configurable as either a transmitter or receiver using a simple DIP switch. This flexibility allows the device to be deployed in various roles within the same system, simplifying inventory and installation requirements.
The 120 series also allows you to create mosaic video walls with image rotation.
Enables seamless Keyboard and Mouse (KM) over IP control with low-latency switching and roaming, ideal for control rooms and collaborative workspaces.

Features built-in security protocols including HTTPS, SSH, and support for 802.1X authentication, ensuring secure data transmission and communication in sensitive environments like government or corporate networks.

Boasting the ultimate in signal flexibility, the 120 Series can discretely deliver audio, infrared, and RS-232 streams separate to the video via a modular IP network. True signal breakaway can create custom assignments.
Compatible with the NetworkHD Touch and Companion Control apps. Control source, matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.
Transmits USB 2.0 data over IP with support for one-to-one and one-to-many connections*
Fully compatible with the NHD-500 series for extended USB device functionality
Compatible with mainstream audio DSPs and video bars, including brands such as Q-SYS, Shure, Biamp, Extron, Yealink, Logitech and more. For details, please refer to the USB compatibility list
Both HDMI and Analog outputs allow discrete audio routing from any available NHD-120-TX on the same network.
Support all SD and HD formats - including interlaced content
Infrared signal generation via API – supports Hex Pronto format

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Compact Class B HDBaseT receiver supporting 4K HDR transmissions up to 35 meters from a compatible HDBaseT matrix or presentation switcher. 2-way PoH allows the RX-35-POH to power over category cable from a PoH matrix or switcher and also allows for the receiver to power in-wall HDBaseT transmitters.

Small in size but not in specification, the RX-35-POH is no different to the modern H2 family of products, supporting pixel-perfect 4K UHD 4:2:0 10-bit @24Hz at distances up to 35m/115ft or 1080p to 35m/115ft.

Supports 3 methods of control pass-through. Being a pure HDBaseT TM device, the RX-35-POH can handle bi-directional IR, RS-232 and even CEC routing when used as part of a compatible WyreStorm matrix or extender system.
The RX-35-POH can be powered by a PoH compatible matrix or presentation switcher meaning one less thing to think about when specifying & installing a WyreStorm system.
2-way PoH enabled for convenient PSU-free installation
HDCP 2.2 | EDID | DVI/D supported with adapter (not included)

The little sibling to the RX-700, the RX-500 also utilizes HDBaseT 2.0 technology extending 4K video, USB 2.0, audio and control point to point up to 35m/115ft. The RX-500 still maintains the ability send HID’s and data back to the transmitter with USB 2.0 compatible devices such as HD webcams, smart white boards and data drives alike. Ideally suited for small meeting spaces and conference rooms, the RX-500 pairs perfectly with WyreStorm’s popular line of Presentation Solutions, such as the SW-130-TX or SW-510-TX to meet all of your presentation needs.

The main feature of the RX-500 is the 4 device ports, which are capable of USB 2.0 pass-through, which offers not only KVM functionality for extension of a keyboard/mouse or touchscreen, but also transfers the highest data rate that HDBaseT has to offer of 190Mbps, for webcams, white boards and USB data drives.

Utilizing the best in HDBaseT technology, the RX-700 extends 5-Play functionality to your display device over 100m/328ft of Cat6 cable. Using DSC (display stream compression) the RX-700 can support HDMI video up to 2160p 4:4:4 at 60Hz without any visual loss in quality or latency. With HID’s and data transfer in mind, the RX-700 supports data transmission of USB 2.0 devices like HD webcams, smart whiteboards and flash drives alike.

Sporting an 18Gbps HDMI input, the RX-700 can support all UHD video signals up to and including 2160p 4:4:4/60, and high frame-rate HDR 12bit 4:2:2 up to 60Hz, along with multichannel audio up to DTS:X and Dolby Atmos.

Running in parallel to and completely separate to the HDMI signal within the HDBaseT link, the RX-700 can also support the bi-directional transmission of 2 separate stereo audio feeds, to and from the RX-700.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Utilizing the best in HDBaseT technology, the RX-700 extends 5-Play functionality to your display device over 100m/328ft of Cat6 cable. Using DSC (display stream compression) the RX-700 can support HDMI video up to 2160p 4:4:4 at 60Hz without any visual loss in quality or latency. With HID’s and data transfer in mind, the RX-700 supports data transmission of USB 2.0 devices like HD webcams, smart whiteboards and flash drives alike.

Sporting an 18Gbps HDMI input, the RX-700 can support all UHD video signals up to and including 2160p 4:4:4/60, and high frame-rate HDR 12bit 4:2:2 up to 60Hz, along with multichannel audio up to DTS:X and Dolby Atmos.

Running in parallel to and completely separate to the HDMI signal within the HDBaseT link, the RX-700 can also support the bi-directional transmission of 2 separate stereo audio feeds, to and from the RX-700.
Compatible with DVI-I and DP++ v1.3 signals from compatible devices

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The very core of WyreStorm transmission, we've embraced HDBaseT technology since 2010. We're now taking the capabilities of HDBaseT to the next level and supporting video bandwidths in excess of 10Gbps with our lossless compression technology built in to out H2X matrix platform. The RXV-70-4K will output HDMI content at up to 2160p 4:4:4/60.

As space between displays and the wall they're mounted to reduces, finding a receiver to fit in this gap can be hard to find. But just because this receiver packs a punch doesn't mean it can't deliver the small footprint that you've come to expect. It also ships complete with all the accessories needed to help the integrator complete the install discreetly and efficiently.
For use exclusively with H2XC matrix and TX-H2X-VLC modular card. Not compatible with MXV matrix range.
Compatible with HDR standards including HDR-10, HDR-10+, HLG and Dolby Vision (Dolby Vision supported up to 30Hz)
Class A HDBaseT supporting the transmission of video, multichannel audio, Ethernet, bidirectional control and PoH
Bidirectional IR supported with both IR TX & RX ports
Supports Ethernet pass-through from matrix (Class A HDBaseT transmission only)
Wall mounting brackets and IR accessories included
HDCP 2.2 | EDID | CEC | DVI-D supported with adapter (not included)
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

18Gbps HDBaseT receiver for the MXV-70 matrix switcher series. The RXV-70-G2-SCL features a powerful scaler that can convert 4K UHD and HDR content to a 1080p non-HDR display to maximize compatibility. The receiver also features stereo and digital S/PDIF audio breakout for easy external audio distribution.

The RXV-70-G2-SCL allows video output to be scaled to match the capabliity of the connected display. Transmit a 4K HDR source to a 4K HDR display and at the same time scale another zone to 1080p without effecting the quality of the source.

The very core of WyreStorm transmission, we’ve embraced HDBaseT technology since 2010. We’re now taking the capabilities of HDBaseT to the next level and supporting video bandwidths in excess of 10Gbps with our lossless compression technology built in to out H2X matrix platform. The RXV-70-G2-SCL will output HDMI content at up to 2160p 4:4:4/60.

The SP-0108-SCL is a small and compact, yet powerful HDMI splitter that can be used in many applications, from digital signage, education, to retail or hospitality. Each HDMI output of the SP-0108-SCL features a 4K to 1080p down scaler, allowing for mixed resolution displays to be used simultaneously without suffering from compatibility limitations. An analog and digital S/PDIF audio de-embed allows easy connection for external amplifiers or DSPs.

Each of the 8 outputs on the SP-0108-SCL feature down scalers, which can be set via dipswitch or API, allowing support for mixed resolution distribution of HDMI content to 4K and 1080p display simultaneously.

Previous professional splitters offered basic EDID management with up to 8 different EDID settings, but the SP-0108-SCL provides more flexibility with its advance EDID management, boasting up to 16 pre-loaded EDIDs to choose from, ensuring reliable and consistent video distribution. We’ve further included a custom EDID setting, allowing you to upload your own unique EDID to use, making the SP-0108-SCL’s EDID library virtually unlimited. To make life even easier, manage EDID information through the API, dipswitches or copy and EDID from a display with the front panel buttons.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The SP-618 is a simple yet powerful HDMI splitter that can be used in many applications from digital signage to retail or hospitality. Each HDMI output of the SP-618 features a 4K to 1080p down scaler, allowing for mixed resolution displays to be used simultaneously without suffering from compatibility limitations. A balanced analog and digital S/PDIF audio de-embed allows easy connection for external amplifiers or DSPs. With a 1U chassis, the SP-618 can be easily fitted in standard 19″ equipment racks for a tidy installation.
As a standard requirement with the latest WyreStorm products, the SP-618 supports the latest video formats including 4K HDR and Dolby Vision content all in uncompressed HDMI glory.
Each of the 8 outputs on the SP-618 feature down scalers, allowing support for mixed resolution distribution of HDMI content to 4K and 1080p display simultaneously.
Uncompressed HDMI signal distribution supporting full 18Gbps bandwidth and 4K60 444 video content
Compatible with latest HDR video standards including HDR10, HDR10+ Dolby Vision and HLG
Each HDMI output supports 4K to 1080p downscaling to support mixed resolution systems
HDCP 2.2 | EDID | CEC | DVI/D supported with adapter (not included)
4K HDR 4:4:4 60Hz HDMI 1x4 Splitter with 1080p Scaling Feature

The SW-0204-VW 4x HDMI 2.0 Video Wall processor is an advanced 2x inputs (alternative) and 4x outputs video wall processor, providing video wall layout of 1x4 and 2x2 (rows x columns) with 4K and ultra-wide resolution support, independent analog audio output and image scaling. It also supports a user-friendly Web-UI, RS232 and Telnet for optimal flexibility control.

The SW-0204-VW supports 4-screen video walls with selectable modes, including 1x4 and 2x2 configurations. It extends the input video source across four displays, delivering stunning visual detail and an enhanced viewing experience. Advanced features, such as bezel correction, video wall flip, and flexible layout adjustments, allow precise customization for seamless multi-screen alignment.

Fully compatible with 4K@60Hz video content, the SW-0204-VW adheres to HDMI 2.0 and HDCP 2.3 standards. Its built-in scaling processor allows both upscaling and downscaling to resolutions up to 4K@60Hz 4:4:4, ensuring superior image quality and a fully immersive visual experience.

Supporting ultra-wide resolutions such as 3840x600, the SW-0204-VW is ideal for landscape-oriented video walls. This feature makes it a perfect choice for digital signage, conference rooms, and large-scale presentations.

The SW-0204-VW offers advanced audio functionality, including audio de-embedding from HDMI inputs and an audio mute option. These features provide clear, reliable audio output, complementing the visual performance of the video wall.

The SW-0204-VW 4x HDMI 2.0 Video Wall processor is an advanced 2x inputs (alternative) and 4x outputs video wall processor, providing video wall layout of 1x4 and 2x2 (rows x columns) with 4K and ultra-wide resolution support, independent analog audio output and image scaling. It also supports a user-friendly Web-UI, RS232 and Telnet for optimal flexibility control.

The SW-0204-VW supports 4-screen video walls with selectable modes, including 1x4 and 2x2 configurations. It extends the input video source across four displays, delivering stunning visual detail and an enhanced viewing experience. Advanced features, such as bezel correction, video wall flip, and flexible layout adjustments, allow precise customization for seamless multi-screen alignment.

Fully compatible with 4K@60Hz video content, the SW-0204-VW adheres to HDMI 2.0 and HDCP 2.3 standards. Its built-in scaling processor allows both upscaling and downscaling to resolutions up to 4K@60Hz 4:4:4, ensuring superior image quality and a fully immersive visual experience.

Supporting ultra-wide resolutions such as 3840x600, the SW-0204-VW is ideal for landscape-oriented video walls. This feature makes it a perfect choice for digital signage, conference rooms, and large-scale presentations.

The SW-0204-VW offers advanced audio functionality, including audio de-embedding from HDMI inputs and an audio mute option. These features provide clear, reliable audio output, complementing the visual performance of the video wall.

A true plug-and-play HDMI switcher, supporting up to four 4K HDR sources to one screen

The WyreStorm EXP-SW-0401-H2 is a powerful plug-and-play 4K switcher solution. With up to 18Gbps pure HDMI support, which allows up to four 4K HDR sources to be routed to a single display. The EXP-SW-0401-H2 is capable of auto switching, giving the user the convenience of simply turning on their favorite device without the requiring manual intervention. Furthermore, the EXP-SW-0401-H2 is equipped with signal compensation, allowing an extender or splitter to connect to its output without degrading or delaying the signal.

A trend you may notice is the plug-and-play features WyreStorm’s Essentials product line possesses and it doesn’t stop at our switchers. You can find the same auto EDID and HDCP negotiation found in other Essentials products, but specifically signal regeneration is what makes WyreStorm’s Essentials switchers the king of plug-and-play!

While the EXP-SW-0401-H2 is a stand-alone device, sometimes wiring to the display is too long for a standard HDMI cable, or maybe there are additional displays added. Because of its signal regeneration feature, additional devices can be connected to the output of the switch, like an extender set or splitter, all without signal delay or degradation.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The little sibling to the RX-700, the RX-500 also utilizes HDBaseT 2.0 technology extending 4K video, USB 2.0, audio and control point to point up to 35m/115ft. The RX-500 still maintains the ability send HID’s and data back to the transmitter with USB 2.0 compatible devices such as HD webcams, smart white boards and data drives alike. Ideally suited for small meeting spaces and conference rooms, the RX-500 pairs perfectly with WyreStorm’s popular line of Presentation Solutions, such as the SW-130-TX or SW-510-TX to meet all of your presentation needs.

The main feature of the RX-500 is the 4 device ports, which are capable of USB 2.0 pass-through, which offers not only KVM functionality for extension of a keyboard/mouse or touchscreen, but also transfers the highest data rate that HDBaseT has to offer of 190Mbps, for webcams, white boards and USB data drives.

HDBaseT switcher/transmitter for video conference or meeting rooms

3 inputs and powerful HDBaseT transmission result is this powerful switching transmitter, perfect for corporate meeting and classroom environments. Automatic or manual switching of 2 HDMI’s or USB-C and CEC power triggering via HDBaseT mean a simple user experience when it matters most. Further functionality allows USB devices to be routed back to the source via USB host (or natively via USB-C) and charging for the connected USB-C device.

Setting a new standard for in-wall HDBaseT transmission, the SW-130-TX-US brings features of the WyreStorm range of professional switchers and packs them into a 2-gang form factor. Automatic or manual switching of the 3 connected sources (2 HDMI and USB-C) is possible with the USB-C supporting alt-mode functionality allowing a portable device such as a tablet or phone to be connected and send its content at up to 4K/30. HDCP 2.2 is also supported for the transmission of encrypted content.

It’s not all about the A/V when it comes to HDBaseT; with increased functionality on all fronts, the SW-130-TX can be used to send power triggers to a compatible connected screen, allowing centralized control and is PoH compatible meaning it can be passively powered over HDBaseT from a compatible receiver. The SW-130-TX can even power & charge a phone or tablet connected to the USB-C port so you don’t run out of juice mid-flow (max. 5v 2A)

The industry’s latest encryption standard designed to stop the illegal copying & distribution of 4K UHD content; no longer unique to residential solutions WyreStorm presentation switchers are fully compliant with HDCP 2.2, enabling you to de-centralize source devices within an installation.

HDBaseT2.0 affords the addition of USB 2.0 pass-through, offering not only KVM functionality for extension of a keyboard/mouse or touchscreen but also full data transfer capabilities. The SW-130-TX has a USB host port allowing USB device data to be routed into the selected laptop (via HDMI). Going further, it can send USB device data natively through the USB-C port allowing a single cable to be used for A/V and USB device connectivity.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

3 inputs and powerful HDBaseT transmission result is this powerful switching transmitter, perfect for corporate meeting and classroom environments. Automatic or manual switching of 2 HDMI’s or USB-C and CEC power triggering via HDBaseT mean a simple user experience when it matters most. Further functionality allows USB devices to be routed back to the source via USB host (or natively via USB-C) and charging for the connected USB-C device.

Setting a new standard for in-wall HDBaseT transmission, the SW-130-TX-US brings features of the WyreStorm range of professional switchers and packs them into a 2-gang form factor. Automatic or manual switching of the 3 connected sources (2 HDMI and USB-C) is possible with the USB-C supporting alt-mode functionality allowing a portable device such as a tablet or phone to be connected and send its content at up to 4K/30. HDCP 2.2 is also supported for the transmission of encrypted content.

It’s not all about the A/V when it comes to HDBaseT; with increased functionality on all fronts, the SW-130-TX can be used to send power triggers to a compatible connected screen, allowing centralized control and is PoH compatible meaning it can be passively powered over HDBaseT from a compatible receiver. The SW-130-TX can even power & charge a phone or tablet connected to the USB-C port so you don’t run out of juice mid-flow (max. 5v 2A)

The industry’s latest encryption standard designed to stop the illegal copying & distribution of 4K UHD content; no longer unique to residential solutions WyreStorm presentation switchers are fully compliant with HDCP 2.2, enabling you to de-centralize source devices within an installation.

HDBaseT2.0 affords the addition of USB 2.0 pass-through, offering not only KVM functionality for extension of a keyboard/mouse or touchscreen but also full data transfer capabilities. The SW-130-TX has a USB host port allowing USB device data to be routed into the selected laptop (via HDMI). Going further, it can send USB device data natively through the USB-C port allowing a single cable to be used for A/V and USB device connectivity.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

3 inputs and powerful HDBaseT transmission result is this powerful switching transmitter, perfect for corporate meeting and classroom environments. Automatic or manual switching of 2 HDMI’s or USB-C and CEC power triggering via HDBaseT mean a simple user experience when it matters most. Further functionality allows USB devices to be routed back to the source via USB host (or natively via USB-C) and charging for the connected USB-C device.

Setting a new standard for in-wall HDBaseT transmission, the SW-130-TX-US brings features of the WyreStorm range of professional switchers and packs them into a 2-gang form factor. Automatic or manual switching of the 3 connected sources (2 HDMI and USB-C) is possible with the USB-C supporting alt-mode functionality allowing a portable device such as a tablet or phone to be connected and send its content at up to 4K/30. HDCP 2.2 is also supported for the transmission of encrypted content.

It’s not all about the A/V when it comes to HDBaseT; with increased functionality on all fronts, the SW-130-TX can be used to send power triggers to a compatible connected screen, allowing centralized control and is PoH compatible meaning it can be passively powered over HDBaseT from a compatible receiver. The SW-130-TX can even power & charge a phone or tablet connected to the USB-C port so you don’t run out of juice mid-flow (max. 5v 2A)

The industry’s latest encryption standard designed to stop the illegal copying & distribution of 4K UHD content; no longer unique to residential solutions WyreStorm presentation switchers are fully compliant with HDCP 2.2, enabling you to de-centralize source devices within an installation.

HDBaseT2.0 affords the addition of USB 2.0 pass-through, offering not only KVM functionality for extension of a keyboard/mouse or touchscreen but also full data transfer capabilities. The SW-130-TX has a USB host port allowing USB device data to be routed into the selected laptop (via HDMI). Going further, it can send USB device data natively through the USB-C port allowing a single cable to be used for A/V and USB device connectivity.

The SW-540-TX-W is the perfect presentation switcher that meets the demanding requirements for today’s meeting spaces and conference rooms. The SW-540-TX-W is fully loaded with connectivity options, including VGA, HDMI and USB-C to ensure every laptop is compatible. In addition to the wired inputs, built-in support for Apple Airplay and Miracast allows devices to screenshare wirelessly by connecting the switcher to an existing LAN or by utilizing the integrated wireless access point. Dual outputs via HDBaseT and HDMI promote connectivity in multi-screen rooms along with the ability to show up to 4 sources simultaneously via multiview. Of course, the package wouldn’t be complete without the ability to connect USB peripherals such as speakerphones and cameras directly to the switcher or over HDBaseT.
A built-in USB hub on the switcher allows local connection of peripherals devices such as a conference speakerphone. USB over HDBaseT allows remote connection of a webcam or PTZ camera.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The SW-640L-TX-W is an advanced wireless presentation and conferencing system, tailored to meet the dynamic requirements of modern meeting spaces and conference rooms. This upgraded model boasts significant enhancements. Key improvements include two USB-C inputs with 60W PD, now featuring Multi Stream Transport (MST) support to unlock advanced connectivity and multi-display workflows. The switcher also includes an upgraded USB 3.0 switcher, further enriched by the support for a wireless host through the APO-DG2/APO-DG2-PRO. This addition allows for more flexible and convenient connections.
Display up to 4 source devices at the same time via Multiview feature, creating a supportive environment for collaboration between colleagues and teams.
A built-in USB 3.0 hub on the switcher allows local connection of peripherals devices such as a conference speakerphone.
Supports input resolutions up to 4K30 4:4:4 via USB-C or HDMI
Supports “Wireless Infrastructure” mode which allows APO-DG2, APO-DG2-PRO and Apple Airplay to work with third party wireless access points
Analog audio output allows extraction of Audio
Compatible with all major conference software including Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Cisco WebEx and more
Compatible with mainstream audio DSPs and video bars, including brands such as Q-SYS, Shure, Biamp, Extron, Yealink, Logitech and more. For details, please refer to the USB compatibility list.
Compatible with Microsoft Teams Rooms(MTR), like Lenovo ThinkSmart Core Gen 1/2 devices.
USB-C input supports alt-mode for both A/V (MST Supported), Ethernet, and Data communication over a single cable
Integrated webserver for control, setup and live monitoring via HTTPS
Easily mountable under a table or desk with included mounting brackets
Wireless access point supports custom SSID, password and screensharing access PIN
Integrated ‘Guide Screen’ with simple instructions to get connected can be modified with custom image
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

The SYN-KEY10 is a simple single-room single gang RS-232 or IP control Keypad designed to be compatible with our Synergy presentation switchers and other 3 rd party devices, to help create a complete solution. Up to 10 customizable keys can be programmed for single-action or multiple-action macro on one button. Build a kit with the SYN-KEY-10 with any of our Synergy products as an all-in-one solution or as a standalone controller for 3 rd party devices.

The SYN-KEY10 provides a comprehensive solution for today's demanding corporate and education applications. Control all aspects of a room ranging from input switching, display power, lighting, shades/blinds, and even create macros which can trigger different scenes in one press.

No complicated wiring needed to get started with the SYN-KEY10! You’ll only need one cable to power and deliver commands over single-standard category cable. If no PoE is present in your installation. If no PoE is present in your installation, a 2-pin local power is available.

Included are 2 sheets of stickers to cover the SYN-KEY10's tactile buttons and with pleanty to choose from! They're strong enough to withstand multiple button touches, but easy to peel off for quick change-outs.
All your creative customization ideas are designed over an easy-to-use Webui. Edit and test commands & devices, create groups, and more with easy to understand menu options.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

This Synergy kit provides an all-in-one solution for BYOD applications. Perfectly suited for education or corporate markets, this kit includes a 3-input HDBaseT in-wall transmitter, HDBaseT receiver and a 2.8” touchscreen controller. Use this kit to create a simple solution for conference rooms, huddle spaces, training rooms, lecture halls or anywhere users will bring their own devices to present.

The in-wall transmitter is a perfect solution for remote inputs. Install it near a podium or in the front of a room to allow BYOD connectivity for presentations. It can also be installed into a table or desk just as easily to provide a sleek, low-profile option for huddle spaces or conference rooms.

Delivering visually lossless 4K UHD content with HDR and HDCP 2.2 support ensures compatibility with the latest UHD video sources, while a built-in scaler ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.

The 2.8” touchscreen provides a simple yet effective user interface for switching inputs on the transmitter and the ability to send CEC commands to turn on or off a remote display. The interface has been pre-built by WyreStorm and doesn’t require any programming

Supporting traditional video walls, as well as customizable mosaic styles, perfect for building captivating & creative digital signage. JPEG2000 encoding ensuring distribution integrity and video latency of less than a single frame makes the 400 Series ideal for live environments.

The transmitter and receiver support USB extension capabilities. This allows laptops to utilize connected peripheral devices such as a remote webcam & speakerphone for online meetings or a touchscreen/smart display for interactive learning experiences.

Boasting the ultimate in signal flexibility, the 400 Series can discretely deliver audio, infrared and USB streams separate to the video via a modular IP network. True signal breakaway can create custom assignments, desirable in both commercial and residential applications.
Pre-configured UI’s designed for simple end-user experience
RJ45 connection and RS-422 communication to included RS-232 converter
Supports content up to 4K/60 4:2:0 or 4K/30 RGB 8-bit
USB-C port supports alt-mode functionality for A/V and USB data
Automatic or manual CEC triggering for compatible connected screens or projectors
Supports content up to 4K/60 4:2:0 or 4K/30 RGB 8-bit up to 35m/115ft
PoH enabled to remote power SW-130-TX transmitter
Supports analog audio pass-through from transmitter to receiver
Supports analog audio de-embed from HDMI output
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

This Synergy kit provides an all-in-one solution for medium-sized presentation applications. Suited for corporate or education markets that require a comprehensive solution for AV distribution and control. This kit includes a 4-input HDBaseT switcher, a feature-packed HDBaseT receiver and a 2.8” touchscreen controller. Use this kit to create a robust solution for medium conference spaces, corporate boardrooms, training centers and many other presentation-based applications.

Every major connection type is supported, including HDMI, USB-C, VGA and DisplayPort ensuring compatibility with all laptops, room PCs, document cameras or media players. AV signals can be sent up to 100m over HDBaseT, ideal for integrating into existing cable infrastructure.

Delivering visually lossless 4K UHD content with HDR and HDCP 2.2 support ensures compatibility with the latest UHD video sources, while a built-in scaler ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.

The 2.8” touchscreen provides a simple yet effective user interface for switching inputs on the transmitter and the ability to send CEC commands to turn on or off a remote display. The interface has been pre-built by WyreStorm and doesn’t require any programming

Supporting traditional video walls, as well as customizable mosaic styles, perfect for building captivating & creative digital signage. JPEG2000 encoding ensuring distribution integrity and video latency of less than a single frame makes the 400 Series ideal for live environments.

The transmitter and receiver support USB extension capabilities. This allows laptops to utilize connected peripheral devices such as a remote webcam & speakerphone for online meetings or a touchscreen/smart display for interactive learning experiences.

Boasting the ultimate in signal flexibility, the 400 Series can discretely deliver audio, infrared and USB streams separate to the video via a modular IP network. True signal breakaway can create custom assignments, desirable in both commercial and residential applications.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The SYN-TOUCH10 is a powerful LAN-based touchpad controller, compatible with WyreStorm solutions and many other third-party LAN controllable devices. The SYN-TOUCH10 is a perfect solution for corporate and education environments by providing a comprehensive control experience for an entire room. The possibilities are endless with a fully programmable and customizable software environment that takes the hassle and frustration out of a typical control system experience. Two-way communication between devices allows for a responsive experience such as knowing which input is selected or if a microphone has been muted.

The SYN-TOUCH10 provides a comprehensive solution for today's demanding corporate and education applications. Control all aspects of a room ranging from input switching, display power, lighting, shades/blinds, and even create macros which can trigger different scenes in one press.

The Synergy software provides a fully customizable user interface allowing you to tailor it to your exact needs. This includes custom button layouts and icons, colors, background images, logos, branding and more!

The TX-35-IW provides simple transmission of remote HDMI sources. Pair with the RX-35-POH for simple yet effective signal extension of 4K UHD content. The TX-35-IW uses standardized HDBaseT and PoH technology, meaning that it is compatible with many WyreStorm models including presentation receivers or the H2XC series of matrix switchers. The TX-35-IW is great for remote input applications including education environments such as training rooms or huddle spaces. It can be remotely powered from a compatible HDBaseT receiver and features IR and RS-232 control signal passthrough.
The TX-35-IW features PoH technology which allows it to be powered from a compatible HDBaseT receiver. Eliminate the need for bulky DC power supplies and remotely power the TX over category cable.

Using standard technologies such as HDBaseT and PoH makes the TX-35-IW compatible with a myriad of WyreStorm receivers such as the SW-515-RX, or even as a remote input into the MX-H2XC for larger deployments.

Offering both an HDMI input & output, the ADZ card provides an 18Gbps link direct to the matrix backplane. Supporting both 2160p 4:4:4 8-bit & HDR content and multi-channel audio formats up to Dolby Atmos TM , it offers the ability to use native HDMI connectivity without the need for a transmission port (reducing cost) and maintains an audio DSP output. It is the perfect partner for WyreStorm’s range of hybrid optical fiber HDMI cables.

Omitting the complex HDBaseT transmission port, this card allows an input, output and audio functionality to still be added to an H2XC matrix. Whether adding just another audio zone or tapping into the 18Gbps backplane for further I/O, this card can still do it all.

The latest 4K UHD content arriving via satellite, cable, disc or stream is all heavily encrypted. Being part of the growing H2 product family, all H2XC matrix cards and peripheral devices support the multi-point distribution of this content over HDMI, HDBaseT and multi-mode fibre.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The USB-HUB4 is a simple add-on accessory for expanding USB connectivity of your devices. Pair this hub with a number of WyreStorm products to help build your full solution. Connect the hub to the CAB-UAOC-15 USB 3.0 extension cable to provide long distance transmission of high-speed USB 3.0. The USB-HUB4 is also a great companion to the Apollo line of unified communication solutions. Although simple, we’ve kept pro installations in mind by including a set of mounting brackets to easily install the hub under a desk or behind a display.
Mounting brackets are included in the box allowing the hub to easily be installed under a desk or behind a table to keep your installations looking tidy.

description: The WyreRing provides a simple yet effective way to ensure compatibility of BYOD in a meeting space without the need for a presentation switcher or over-specified system. The simple adapter ring provides 3 HDMI converters: USB-C, DisplayPort and Mini DisplayPort. All 3 converters support up to 4K60 video passthrough. The secure cable lock attaches to any HDMI cable up to 10mm in diameter. The metal reinforced ring provides a strong and durable connection to the converters that won’t wear out after repeated use.
